pages.title: Staying Outside the 2% Price Limit Zone
pages.content:
Who this applies to: The 2% rule applies to all Topstep account types, including the Trading Combine®, Express Funded Account™ and Live Funded Account.
What Are CME Price Limits?
A price limit is the maximum price range a futures contract can move in a single trading session. When a limit is hit, the exchange may halt trading, expand limits, or stop the session entirely, depending on the product.
Price limits are calculated from the previous day’s settlement price. They update at 4:05 PM CT after each session and vary by product, contract month, and time of day.
Overnight limits differ from RTH limits.
➡ Check current CME Price Limits here — they change regularly.
📣 Update: Equity products ES, MES, NQ, MNQ, RTY, M2K, YM, and MYM overnight price limits have expanded from 5% to 7%.
How to Stay Outside the 2% Price Limit
☝️ Method 1: Watch % Net Change
Add the % Net Change column to the platform’s Quote Board. Stop trading when % Net Change approaches the limit minus 2%.
👉 Example : 5% limit → stop trading at 3% net change. 7% limit → stop trading at 5% net change.
✌️ Method 2: Calculate from Settlement Price
Formulas:
Stop trading above: Settlement × (1 + Price Limit% − 2%)
Stop trading below: Settlement × (1 − Price Limit% + 2%)
Example using ES settlement of 2,814.00 with a 5% limit:
Stop above: 2,814 × 1.03 = 2,898
Stop below: 2,814 × 0.97 = 2,730
With a 7% downside-only limit:
Stop below: 2,814 × 0.95 = 2,673
Why Does Topstep Enforce This?
To protect the firm and its Traders. When a product is within 2% of a price limit, market conditions are extreme and execution is unreliable. Every Trader should know the contract specs and limits for every product they trade.
📑 For product details, visit CME Group and select your contract.
📺 Check out the video below to learn more about trading around price limits.

pages.title: Prohibited Conduct
pages.content:
Prohibited Conduct applies at every level of the Topstep program. It protects program integrity and makes sure passing the Trading Combine® actually means something. Violations are reviewed case-by-case based on severity and history.
Possible responses to a Prohibited Conduct violation:
Warning
Deletion of the impacted trading day
Account Reset
Permanent account closure
Delay or denial of a Payout request
Ultimately, the action Topstep takes will depend on the infractions severity and your prior history (or lack thereof).
What Is Prohibited Conduct?
Unprofessional behavior — see Professional Behavior at Topstep
Excessive purchases of Trading Combines or Resets
Price exploitation — strategies designed to exploit errors in price display or data feed delays
Disruptive practices — including spoofing
Trading outside the best bid or offer
Using an external or slow data feed to trade
Coordinated trading — performing trades in concert with others (including unconnected accounts or third parties) to pool risk, hedge aggregate positions, or trade the same or opposite strategy simultaneously
Cross-account hedging (single-user) — holding opposite positions across multiple accounts simultaneously
Trades conflicting with Topstep’s Terms of Use
Unfair technology — using software, AI, ultra-high speed systems, or mass data entry to gain an unfair advantage
Trading inconsistent with real futures markets — or in a way that creates financial risk for Topstep
Bad-Faith Disputes — filing a bad-faith dispute against a payment to Topstep, or improperly reversing a charge for services received. Before disputing a charge with your bank, please contact us; we can often resolve it faster. Learn more here .
Exploiting platform deficiencies — using instruments or methods that misuse bugs, errors, or deficiencies in the platform
Circumventing geographical or technical restrictions
Holding a position within 2% of a product’s price lock limit — see How to Ensure I Am Not Trading Within 2% of a Price Limit
Trading on behalf of others — including sharing incentives as part of any business arrangement
Account stacking — repeatedly hitting the Maximum Loss Limit in one account and switching to another to repeat high-risk attempts
Any other conduct that Topstep determines, at its sole discretion, is uncommercial, games the market, is not a viable strategy, or is not responsible trading
Do not use a VPN. VPNs, proxy services, TOR, geo-location obfuscation, and other identity-masking services are not permitted at Topstep. If you see an Error 403 Forbidden message, disable your VPN or proxy and try again.
Prohibited Conduct regarding Trader Profiles:
Harmful, offensive, illegal, or sexual content
Personal Data or misleading claims
Unauthorized names, trademarks, or third-party content
Advertising, scams, or attempts to evade moderation
Notice that Profile Content may undergo automated screening and moderation, which may result in profile suspension or deactivation
🤝 Trading with friends & family is part of the Ultimate Trading Experience. Just keep it by the book — no coordinated group trading, no account-sharing, no single-account rule workarounds.
Why is there a hold on my profile?
Our Internal Teams routinely review all Topstep profiles for compliance with the Topstep Terms of Use and program integrity. If something needs a closer look, we may place a hold on your profile.
When a hold is active:
You can’t purchase or request Payouts.
A banner appears at the top of your Topstep Dashboard.
What to do:
Support can’t see why a hold was placed.
Wait 7 business days. The hold will be lifted, or we’ll reach out with next steps.
Still on hold after 7 business days? Contact Support .
Who are the Topstep Internal Teams?
The Internal Teams protects the integrity of the program. If your conduct is called into question, they're who you'll hear from.
Our Internal Teams review Terms of Use violations, fraudulent activity, and account manipulation. They do not handle platform or technical issues — that's Trader Support.
Appeals
If you've been banned from Topstep, you may submit an appeal. To learn more about Appeals, please go here .
FAQs
​ What if I just create a new profile?
Don't. New profiles created during a hold, or after a ban will be closed immediately and no refunds will be issued.
​ Do I need to verify my identity?
Yes. Topstep conducts IDV (Identity Verification) checks on all Traders. You may be asked to re-verify at any time. Learn more about how IDV works.
Can I request a Payout while on hold?
No. A hold pauses Payout requests and purchases until it’s lifted.
How long does a hold last?
Wait 7 business days. The hold will be lifted, or we’ll reach out with next steps.
View the full Prohibited Conduct section in the Terms of Use

pages.title: Live Funded Account Parameters
pages.content:
The Basics
Real capital. Real markets. The Live Funded Account® (LFA) is the big leagues — Topstep's money behind you, no Payout caps, and unlimited growth potential. When the call-up comes, all Express Funded Accounts (XFA) close. This is what you've been working toward.
Live Account Size
Your LFA size is based on the average account size (the funded tier of each XFA — $50K, $100K, or $150K — not the current balance) of all active, eligible XFAs with at least 1 Payout. If you haven't requested any Payouts yet, all XFAs are averaged together. The average is rounded up to the nearest tier ($50K, $100K, or $150K).
Example: Four 50K XFAs + one 150K XFA = 70K average → rounds up to $100K LFA .
Starting Balance and Reserve
Two numbers set your Live starting balance:
Account Size — the average of your eligible XFAs, rounded up to the nearest tier. This is a hard cap ($25K, $50K, $100K, $150K, or $250K)
Cumulative balance — the actual balances in those XFAs, added together. Remember: what transfers is capped at the account size.
What transfers then splits:
20% available to trade immediately — minimum $10,000*
80% held in Reserve — released in 4 increments of 25% as you hit profit thresholds
*Except the $25K Live Funded Account, which has a minimum starting balance of $5,000
Example: Four $50K XFAs holding $25K each. Account Size = $50K. Cumulative balance was $100K, so $50K is forfeited. → $10K to trade, $40K in Reserve.
👉 Heads up: all Express Funded Accounts are averaged together, so new Topstep Labs accounts may affect your account size.
Capital Expansion — Unlocking Your Reserve
Reserve funds unlock in 25% increments each time you hit the Profit Target for your LFA size. The Profit Target mirrors your Trading Combine® profit target:
LFA Size
| Profit Target to Unlock Reserve Increment
$25K
| $2,000
$50K
| $3,000
$100K
| $6,000
$150K
| $9,000
$250K
| $15,000
Capital Expansion is:
Reviewed every Monday morning
Funds deposited within 1-2 business days
Can be delayed or denied for excessive or reckless risk behavior
You cannot unlock multiple tiers with a single large win — each threshold requires net profit since the last expansion .
Important: If your LFA balance drops below $1,000 , the account may be immediately liquidated and closed at end of the trading day. The remaining balance would then be sent as a final Payout.
​
​ Example: Account drops to $800 = auto liquidation and account closure at the end of that day. The remaining $800 is sent as a final Payout. Unlocked reserve is forfeited.
Daily Loss Limit and Maximum Position Size
Maximum Position Size: The maximum number of contracts you can hold open at one time, per account. Your Maximum Position Size is affected by your performance in the Live Funded Account. Learn more here: Dynamic Live Risk Expansion
Live Funded Accounts start with a Daily Loss Limit (DLL) based on account size:
LFA Size
| Standard DLL
$25K
| $1,000
$50K
| $2,000
$100K
| $3,000
$150K
| $4,500
$250K
| $5,000
Regardless of account size, if your tradable balance drops to lower thresholds, the DLL and Maximum Position Size automatically adjust:
Tradable Balance
| DLL
| Max Position Size
$10,000 or below
| $2,000
| 5
$5,000 or below
| $1,000
| 3
☝️ When limits change:
Decreases: Any day of the week, usually by end of day (EOD).
Increases: Fridays only. If your balance rose above a threshold that week, your DLL and Maximum Position Size are raised back up.
Example: Your balance drops below a threshold on Tuesday. Your limits are lowered that day. Your balance recovers on Wednesday. Your limits stay lower until Friday.
Shoulder Tap Express Funded Account
A Shoulder Tap XFA is a simulated funded account created after a call down from Live. Part of the LFA risk framework — a structured path back to Live trading if needed. Call-back is discretionary, based on overall trading behavior. Learn more →
Live Funded Account FAQs
Can I decline the invitation to move to Live and stay in my XFA?
No. Once the Risk Team determines you're ready, your options are to move to Live or close your Express Funded Account.
How long does it take to create a Live Funded Account?
7 to 10 business days. Topstep will notify you as soon as it's ready.
How is my Live Funded Account size determined if I haven't received any Payouts yet?
In most cases, only Express Funded Accounts with at least 1 Payout are used to calculate your LFA size. However, if you haven't received any Payouts at the time you're called up, all of your active, eligible Express Funded Accounts will be averaged together instead.
Can I have more than one Live Funded Account?
You can only have one (1) Live Funded Account active. When you receive a Live Funded Account, all Express Funded Accounts are closed.
If I lose my LFA, can I go straight back to an XFA without a Trading Combine?
No. You must pass a Trading Combine first. From there, demonstrate consistency in an XFA before being called back up to Live.
Can I take Payouts before unlocking all my Reserve?
Yes. Payout eligibility is not tied to capital expansion. You can take Payouts while still trading with partial account access.
How do I request a Payout?
👉 Check out our Payout Policy for steps
Is the live trading capital my money?
No. It's Topstep's prop firm capital made available as you demonstrate consistent performance. Once you withdraw funds via a Payout, those funds are yours.
Can I unlock multiple Reserve tiers at once with a big win?
No. Each tier requires net profit since the last expansion, reviewed weekly. Single oversized wins do not bypass this.
Can I use automated strategies in my LFA?
The API Gateway is built for the simulated environment and isn't available on Live, so automated strategies are not possible at this time in the Live Funded Account.
How does trading Live benefit me over SIM?
Everything counts here. Real capital, real consequences, real payouts with no cap. The XFA proved your strategy works — Live is where you get paid like it. Trading Live is the goal. It means managing real money, which helps develop discipline and skills under real market conditions, preparing you for real-world trading at Topstep and beyond.
Once I have 30 winning days, can I take a 100% payout?
Yes. We encourage Traders to take full advantage of the benefits of Live trading with Topstep, including unlimited growth potential and daily Payouts. Please note that Payouts can only be taken from your unlocked balance, not from your Live Funded Account Reserve.​ Please note: withdrawing the full balance will close your account.
As you reach each profit target, additional funds are released from your Reserve into your unlocked balance. Once 100% of your balance has been unlocked, you may withdraw those funds as well.
What happens if my Live account closes?
Traders moved from the Live program may be placed in the Responsible Trading Program (RTP) .
What happens if I lose my 20% starting balance?
If your Live Funded Account balance drops below $1,000, the account will be liquidated immediately and closed at the end of the trading day. The remaining balance will be sent to you as a final payout before the account is closed.
​
​ Example: Account drops to $800 = auto liquidation and account closure at the end of that day. The remaining $800 is sent as a final Payout. Unlocked reserve is forfeited.
What happens if I go inactive?
Live Funded Accounts with no trading activity for more than 30 days may be closed. Live Funded Accounts can't be put on hold.
Can I have Trading Combines while I have a Live Funded Account?
Yes. You can have Trading Combines while actively trading a Live Funded Account. The restriction is only on activation — a passed Trading Combine cannot be activated into an Express Funded Account while your Live Funded Account is active. That option becomes available again if the Live Funded Account is lost.
Tip: You can duplicate trades across multiple accounts using a trade copier. Learn more here .

pages.title: What is the Maximum Loss Limit?
pages.content:
The Maximum Loss Limit (MLL) is the lowest point your account balance is allowed to reach. If your balance hits it at any point during the trading day, including on unrealized P&L, your account is liquidated immediately.
Account Size
| Maximum Loss Limit
$50K
| $2,000
$100K
| $3,000
$150K
| $4,500
⚠️ The MLL cannot be adjusted or changed. Topstep makes no exceptions.
Trailing vs. static MLL
Type
| How it works
Trailing
| Rises as your end-of-day balance grows. Never moves down. Locks permanently once it reaches your starting balance.
Static
| Never moves. Stays at the same level no matter how much your balance grows.
All of Topstep’s original products use a trailing MLL. An account uses a static MLL only if its parameters say so. See Topstep Labs , Topstep Limited Products , and Trading Combine® Parameters .
📺 Watch: How the Maximum Loss Limit works
In the Trading Combine
Your account starts at the full account size (e.g., $50,000 for a 50K Trading Combine), and your Maximum Loss Limit starts $2,000 below that.
​
Example:
You start a 50K Trading Combine. Balance: $50,000. MLL: $48,000.
You make $500 on day 1, balance rises to $50,500, MLL trails up to $48,500.
You lose $500 on day 2, balance drops back to $50,000, but MLL stays at $48,500.
In the Express Funded Account
Your Express Funded Account (XFA) balance starts at $0. The 50K, 100K, or 150K label refers to your buying power, not your starting balance. You build your balance from trading profits.
For a 50K XFA, your MLL starts at -$2,000 and trails upward. Once your balance reaches $2,000, the MLL locks at $0 permanently. From that point on, your balance can never fall below $0.
Example: You start a 50K XFA at $0. Day 1: +$500, balance $500, MLL -$1,500.
Day 2: +$1,500, balance $2,000, MLL locks at $0.
👉 After your first Payout: Your MLL is set to $0 regardless of where it was before. The remaining balance becomes your effective loss floor.
​ Example: Balance $10,000. Take a $5,000 Payout. Balance $5,000, MLL $0. If your balance ever hits $0, the account closes.
In the Live Funded Account
For the Live Funded Account, refer here .
Static MLL
The static MLL never moves. Your room to lose grows as your balance grows.
Account Size
| Static MLL
$25K Trading Combine
| $1,000
$50K Trading Combine
| $2,000
$100K Trading Combine
| $4,000
$150K Trading Combine
| $6,000
Static MLL can differ from trailing MLL for the same account size. For example, a $100K Static Trading Combine has a $4,000 MLL. A $100K trailing account has a $3,000 MLL.
In a Static Trading Combine
Example ($50K Static Trading Combine, $2,000 MLL):
You start with a balance of $50,000. MLL: $48,000.
You earn $2,000. Balance rises to $52,000.
You lose $1,000. Balance drops to $51,000.
The static MLL stays at $48,000.
In a Static Express Funded Account
A static XFA balance also starts at $0. Your MLL starts below $0 and never moves. The starting MLL depends on your account size. On a $50K Static XFA, it starts at -$2,000.
Example ($50K Static XFA):
You start at $0. MLL: -$2,000.
Day 1: +$500. Balance $500. MLL stays at -$2,000.
Day 2: +$1,500. Balance $2,000. MLL still stays at -$2,000. A trailing XFA would have locked at $0 here.
After your first Payout, the MLL is set to $0, the same as every XFA.
Static in a Challenge
A Challenge has 2 rounds: the Challenge Round and the Payout Round. Both rounds start at a $0 balance. Both use the same static MLL, and it never moves.
Challenge
| Static MLL (both rounds)
$1.5K Challenge
| $500
$3K Challenge
| $1,000
$6K Challenge
| $2,000
Example ($3K Challenge, $1,000 MLL):
You start the Challenge Round at $0. MLL: -$1,000.
You make $2,000. Balance: $2,000. MLL stays at -$1,000.
You lose $1,500. Balance: $500. MLL still stays at -$1,000.
Passing the Challenge Round advances you to the Payout Round. The static MLL stays the same.
FAQs
When is the trailing MLL calculated?
The MLL updates at the end of each trading day but is monitored in real time throughout the session. Both realized and unrealized P&L count toward it. If your Net P&L hits the limit at any point during the day, your account is liquidated immediately.
​
What happens if I break the MLL?
Trading Combine: Your account is liquidated for the rest of the trading day and becomes ineligible for funding until you Reset. You can still practice trade.
Challenge: Your account is liquidated and closed.
Express Funded Account: Your account is permanently closed. Back2Funded may be available if you're eligible.
Live Funded Account® (LFA): Learn more .
What happens to my MLL when I use Back2Funded?
When you Reactivate using Back2Funded , your account restarts completely. Balance resets to $0, and all stats reset to zero.
Your MLL resets to the starting value for your account size:
Account Size
| Starting MLL (Trailing XFA)
$50K XFA
| -$2,000
$100K XFA
| -$3,000
$150K XFA
| -$4,500
The MLL trails upward as your balance grows and locks at $0 once reached, same as a brand new XFA. Back2Funded is not available for static XFAs.
Can I request that my Maximum Loss Limit be adjusted in my account?
Maximum Loss Limits cannot be adjusted or changed on your account. Topstep does not make exceptions to the Maximum Loss Limit for any account
Why Was My Account Liquidated If My Final Balance Was Above the Risk Limit?
Risk limits are monitored in real-time using Net P&L — both realized and unrealized. If your account touches or falls below a limit at any point, it's a violation and liquidation triggers immediately.
When liquidation fires, positions close via market orders. Slippage and price movement during execution can push your final realized balance back above the limit — but the violation already happened based on unrealized P&L.
Example
Maximum Loss Limit: $48,000 | Balance: $50,000
Open trade moves against you → unrealized P&L drops balance to $47,750
MLL breached → liquidation triggered
Price moves favorably during exit → final realized balance: $48,050
Final balance above the limit doesn't matter. The breach happened first. Same logic applies to the Daily Loss Limit, Personal Daily Loss Limit, and Personal Daily Profit Target.
Best Practices
Use stop losses before approaching your Maximum Loss Limit
Monitor unrealized P&L — not just closed trades
Leave a buffer above your limit during volatile markets
Avoid trading during high-impact news events
How do I know if my account has a static MLL?
Check the account’s parameters. They say whether the MLL is static. If they don’t, the account uses a trailing MLL.
⚠️ Your Maximum Loss Limit is calculated on real-time unrealized P&L. The moment your open loss hits the threshold, the system automatically closes your position via market order; slippage may push the fill slightly above or below the limit, but if the threshold was breached while the trade was open, the liquidation stands.

pages.title: Consistency at Topstep
pages.content:
Consistency rules exist because big spike days don't build funded traders. Sustainable habits do. Here's how the Consistency rules work in the Trading Combine® and the Express Funded Account®.
Trading Combine — Consistency Target (55%)
Your single best day of profit must stay at or below 55% of your Profit Target. If it exceeds that, your Profit Target increases. You'll need to earn more to pass.
​ Formula: Best Day Profit ÷ Total Profit = Best Day %
​ Best Day Recommendations (stay below these to avoid a Profit Target increase):
Account Size
| Profit Target
| Best Day Recommendation
$50K
| $3,000
| Less than $1,650
$100K
| $6,000
| Less than $3,300
$150K
| $9,000
| Less than $4,950
Example: $50K account: $1,600 best day ÷ $3,000 total profit = 53% ✅ — Consistency Target met.
55% is a hard line. It is not rounded, and there is no buffer. You can pass in as few as 2 days, as long as no single day exceeds 55% of your total profit and your Profit Target is met.
⚠️ Losses do not reset your best day. The Consistency Target applies regardless of your current account balance.
How does the Best Day lock in?
Your best day updates throughout the session as your P&L moves. At 3:10 PM CT, that day's value locks into your trading history and cannot be changed. A future day becomes your new best day if it exceeds the previous one and locks at 3:10 PM CT on its own day.
What happens if I have a losing day?
Losses don't reset your best day. If your best day is $1,800 but a losing day brings your total profit down to $1,000, your best day is still $1,800.
To find your new Profit Target: Best Day ÷ 0.55 = Total Profit Needed.
Example: On a $50K account, a $1,800 best day ÷ 0.55 = a $3,273 Profit Target. You now need to reach $3,273 without letting any single day exceed $1,800. If your next day earns $2,200, your best day becomes $2,200 and your new Profit Target becomes $4,000.
Can I fix a Consistency increase by trading more on the same day?
No. If your best day was set during the current trading session (before 3:10 PM CT), any additional profit you earn today adds directly to that best day total — which raises your adjusted Profit Target even further.
​
To resolve a Consistency Target increase, the remaining profit must be earned on a separate trading day, after the market close of the session in which your best day was set.
​
Example : You're in a $50K Trading Combine with a $3,000 Profit Target. Your best day is $2,200 (set today, session still open), so your adjusted Profit Target is $4,000. Trading more today to earn the remaining $1,800 will not work. Every dollar you earn today increases your best day total, which keeps raising the target.
Can I keep trading after hitting my Best Day Recommendation?
Yes, but exceeding it increases your Profit Target and makes the Trading Combine harder to pass.
What happened to the buffer?
There is no buffer. 55% is the hard limit. The old buffer was quiet padding on top of a 50% target. Now the number you see is the number that counts, so there's nothing hidden to account for.
💡 Tip: On TopstepX™, you can set a Personal Daily Profit Target to lock in your gains before exceeding the Consistency Target. Go to Settings, then Risk Settings, set your dollar amount and action (Do Nothing, Liquidate, or Liquidate and Block), then save. Read more or watch the video .
Express Funded Account Consistency — Consistency Objective (40%)
The Consistency path in the Express Funded Account® (XFA) rewards Traders who build profit steadily, not in one big day. When you activate your XFA, you choose Standard or Consistency as your Payout path. The Consistency path gets you to Payout eligibility faster but adds a 40% threshold.
Formula: Largest Single-Day Net Profit ÷ Total Net Profit = Consistency %
Your Consistency % must be 40% or below to be Payout eligible. This is not rounded. Any result above 40% does not qualify.
To request a Payout, you must also have:
A minimum of 3 trading days with at least 1 trade per day
Example: $3,600 largest day ÷ $9,500 total net profit = 37.9% ✅
If your Consistency % exceeds 40%, keep trading. As you earn more net profit, the percentage will naturally come down.
👉 Your dashboard will shows your Consistency % at the end of each trading day which locks in at 4:00 PM CT. Your total net profit, largest single-day profit, and Payout eligibility status will all be visible.
​ Does Consistency reset after a Payout?
Yes. After a Payout is requested, your consistency calculation resets to $0 and applies only to profits earned in the new window. All eligibility requirements must be met again.
The new window starts on the trading day after your Payout was requested. Trades made on the same day as your Payout request do not count toward your next Consistency Objective, even if made after the request was submitted.
👉 Consistency Examples
You request a Payout on Monday. Your new window starts on Tuesday. Profits from Monday don't carry over.
​
You earn $15,000 across 3 days and request a $5,000 Payout on day 3. Your balance drops to $10,000, but your consistency resets to $0. That $10,000 remaining does not count as profit in your new window. You need to earn new profits starting the next trading day.

pages.title: Topstep Labs
pages.content:
The Basics
Topstep is always innovating — and Topstep Labs is where that shows up first. You've probably had ideas a prop firm should try. An account structure that made sense. A feature that could help. A program you wished existed. Labs is where those ideas get tested for real.
​
Not just concepts — actual experiments you can trade right now. Most Labs drops are limited; when it's gone, it's gone. Some Labs ideas graduate into the full Topstep experience. Others won't. But every drop teaches us something. This article tracks every Labs offering as it launches — full details and dates, all in one place.
​
👉 You can also visit topstep.com/labs to see what's live and sign up to stay in the know.
How Topstep Labs Works
We drop an experiment. A new Labs offering goes live as a limited drop.
You trade it. Real Traders, real data. This is how we find out if an idea actually works.
We see what works. Some experiments make it out of the lab and into the full Topstep program.
The Scientist Behind Labs
Topstep acquired Futures Desk because we knew how much they cared about the development of futures Traders. Josh Schwartzberg was the man behind Futures Desk — and now he's the Head Scientist behind Topstep Labs.
"We built Futures Desk because we believed traders deserved a better way to learn. Topstep Labs gives us the opportunity to bring those ideas to life at Topstep's scale. A place to test new opportunities, explore new ideas, and help traders become better traders."
Josh Schwartzberg

Daily Payout details:
After your first Payout, you must be net positive since your last Payout.
Payouts come from profits made during the trading day, locked in at 4:00 PM CT.
5 p.m. CT is the cutoff for a Payout request. Any request after 5 p.m. CT applies to the next trade day.
Taking a daily Payout on an XFA sets your Maximum Loss Limit to $0, no matter where it was before. Your remaining balance becomes your effective loss floor.
Daily Payout example (either version): You have $3,200 in profit. After the $2,000 buffer, $1,200 is available. You can request between $250 and $1,200 today.
⚠️ Any Payout resets your 5 Winning Days count. Want the 5 Winning Days path? Hold off on daily Payouts until you have 5 new winning days.

Frequently Asked Questions
$25K Static Trading Combine
What does "static drawdown" mean, and how is it different from trailing drawdown?
Topstep uses 2 types of drawdown. Here's how each works using the same scenario: a Trader starts with a $25,000 balance and a $1,000 Max Loss Limit, earns $1,000 in profit (balance hits $26,000), then loses $500 (balance ends at $25,500).
End-of-Day (EOD) Trailing (standard Topstep Trading Combines): The Max Loss Limit trails the end-of-day closing balance — not intraday peaks. Trader ends at $25,500, limit moves to $24,500. They start the next day with $1,000 of room.
​
Static (this Trading Combine): The Max Loss Limit never moves. It stays at $24,000 no matter what. With a $28,000 balance, the Trader has $4,000 of room — not $3,000.

Will the $25k Static Trading Combine Rebill each month?
No. The $25k Static Trading Combine has a one-time fee — no Rebill, no subscription. Please note, this Trading Combine expires 90 days after purchase. If you haven't passed by then, it will close automatically.

Yes, this is a separate product and does not replace or affect any existing Trading Combines you may have.

Visit the Topstep Labs page . The $250K Freedom Trading Combine will be displayed as an offer with all the details.

Can I buy more than one?
Yes. There's no cap on how many you can buy, and the Challenge is repeatable — you can buy and run another one. One limit to know: you can only have 5 Challenges in the Payout Round at one time. That's separate from the 5 Express Funded Account® (XFA) limit.
​
​ Example: if you hold 5 XFAs and 10 Challenges, up to 5 of those Challenges can advance to the Payout Round at once.
Is this a limited time offering?
Yes, this release is limited availability; first come, first serve. There is no limit on how many a single Trader can purchase. Once all spots are sold, it's no longer available for purchase.
Is this a subscription?
No. One-time purchase. No Rebills, no Resets.
​
​ How does the account move from Challenge Round to Payout Round, and how do you earn a payout?

$50K Static Trading Combine
What does "static drawdown" mean, and how is it different from trailing drawdown?
Here's how each works using the same $50K scenario: a Trader starts with a $50,000 balance and a $2,000 Maximum Loss Limit , earns $2,000 in profit (balance hits $52,000), then loses $1,000 (balance ends at $51,000).
End-of-Day (EOD) Trailing (standard Topstep Trading Combines): The Maximum Loss Limit trails the end-of-day closing balance, not intraday peaks. Trader ends at $51,000, limit moves to $49,000. They start the next day with $2,000 of room.
Static (this Trading Combine): The Maximum Loss Limit never moves. It stays at $48,000 no matter what. The Trader starts the next day with $3,000 of room. Grow the balance to $56,000 and that room is $8,000.

What's the difference between EOD and Static?
​ 4 things change: price, Profit Target, how the Maximum Loss Limit behaves, and the 5 Winning Days max Payout. With End-of-Day (EOD), the $2,000 Maximum Loss Limit trails your end-of-day balance. With Static, it never moves. Everything else is identical, including the Payout paths.
What does "static drawdown" mean, and how is it different from standard End-of-Day trailing drawdown?
Here's how each works using the same $50K scenario: a Trader starts with a $50,000 balance and a $2,000 Maximum Loss Limit , earns $2,000 in profit (balance hits $52,000), then loses $1,000 (balance ends at $51,000).
End-of-Day (EOD) Trailing: The Maximum Loss Limit trails the end-of-day closing balance, not intraday peaks. Trader ends at $51,000, limit moves to $49,000. They start the next day with $2,000 of room.
Static: The Maximum Loss Limit never moves. It stays at $48,000 no matter what. The Trader starts the next day with $3,000 of room.
Do both versions get the same Payout options?
Yes. EOD and Static both give you daily and 5 Winning Days Payouts. The version you buy only sets the 5 Winning Days max Payout.
How do I choose between daily and 5 Winning Days?
You choose every time you request a Payout. You'll see the paths you're eligible for and pick one. You can switch every Payout.
What happens after I pass the Trading Combine?
You activate an Express Funded Account for free after identity verification. You don't pick a Payout path yet. That happens when you request your first Payout.

Can I take a daily Payout on profit I just made?
4:00 PM CT is when your profits for the day are locked in. You can request a daily Payout after 4:00 PM CT on profits made earlier that day, as long as you meet the other requirements. If you request before 4:00 PM CT, only profits made the day before or earlier apply.

Yes. A daily Payout works like any other Payout and resets your winning days count. On an XFA, it also sets your Maximum Loss Limit to $0, no matter where it was before. Your remaining balance becomes your effective loss floor.

End-of-Day (EOD) Trailing (standard Topstep Trading Combines): The Maximum Loss Limit trails the end-of-day closing balance, not intraday peaks. Trader ends at $153,000, limit moves to $147,000. They start the next day with $6,000 of room.
Static (this Trading Combine): The Maximum Loss Limit never moves. It stays at $144,000 no matter what. The Trader starts the next day with $9,000 of room. Grow the balance to $168,000 and that room is $24,000.
How much does it cost?
$279, one time (subject to taxes). No Rebills, no Resets. The Responsible Trading Discount does not apply.
Is this a limited release and can I buy more than 1?
You can buy five $150K Static Trading Combines each month! You can hold other Trading Combines alongside it. Standard limits still apply to how many active Express Funded Accounts you can have at once.
Who is eligible to purchase this?
All Traders — new and existing — can purchase the $150K Static Trading Combine , up to 5 times per month. However, if you are in an Live Funded Account or a Pro Account, please know that you cannot activate any Express Funded Accounts, even those that come from Labs.
Are there restricted products for the $150K Static Trading Combine?
In the $150K Static Trading Combine, MCL and MGC are set to a max of 90 lots, and CL, GC, HO, QM, and RB are set to a max of 9 lots. SIL and MHG are set to a max of 7 lots. MBT is set to a max of 15 lots. PL, HG, and SI cannot be traded, which is standard for all Trading Combines. Learn more here .
What happens after I pass the $150K Static Trading Combine?
You move to an Express Funded Account® (XFA) with a free activation fee. Pick your path:
Standard: No consistency requirement
Consistency: 40% Consistency Target
Both paths have a $12,000 Payout cap and a $6,000 Maximum Loss Limit (static until first Payout). After your first Payout, the MLL sets to $0.
Is there a limit on how many Payouts I can take?
No hard cap on the number of Payouts. Our Risk team decides on Live call-ups at its discretion.
Does the $150K Static Trading Combine lead to a Live Funded Account® (LFA)?
Yes. Like other Trading Combines, it can lead to a Live Funded Account. Sizing mirrors the standard $150K Trading Combine, and our team makes the call-up decision. If you're called up:
Minimum starting balance: $10,000
Daily Loss Limit: $4,500
Max Contracts: 15 lots, reducing to a minimum of 3 lots if tradable balance declines
Scale In Scale Up: Same as the standard $150K Trading Combine
Learn more about Scale In Scale Up .
What instruments can I trade?
The same instruments as the standard $150K Trading Combine. See When and What Products Can I Trade for details.
Where do I find the $150K Static Trading Combine?
Visit the Topstep Labs page . It shows up as an offer card with the details and a button to purchase!
What happens if I want a refund?
Our standard Topstep Refund Policies apply.
What are the rules on inactivity?
If there are no trades placed for 30 days, the account will close.
Is there an expiration date?
The account will expire and close after 90 days.

Risk Adjustments: High Risk/High Volatility

pages.title: Topstep Payout Policy
pages.content:
Topstep's Payout policy is one of the best in the game — and it's built for Traders who put in the work. Stack 30 winning days in your Live Funded Account® and you unlock daily access to up to 100% of your profits. Put in the reps. The Payouts follow.
The Basics
Request Payouts in the Express Funded Account (XFA) and Live Funded Account (LFA) via your Topstep Dashboard
Available during CME market hours: Sunday 5 PM CT – Friday 5 PM CT (excluding holidays)
Minimum Payout: $125
90/10 profit split — you keep 90%
2 paths. 1 goal. Express Funded Account® Standard. Express Funded Account® Consistency. Pick your lane.

⚠️ Note for traders who joined the new Topstep dashboard before January 12, 2026: You receive 100% of your first $10,000 in lifetime profits. After that, the 90/10 split applies. Payouts from the Legacy dashboard do not contribute to the first $10K.
Payout caps by account size

👉 Payout caps apply to XFA accounts only. Live Funded Account Payouts are not capped. Another reason Live is the goal — no ceiling, no clock, no limit on the upside.
Remember: The XFA isn't where you run up stats. Take your Payouts, stay consistent, and position yourself for Live — where there are no caps and no ceiling on what you can earn.
⏰ Limited Time Offering: Add a Daily Loss Limit (DLL) at checkout in the Trading Combine, and increase your Payout Cap once you pass and activate an Express Funded Account. Available starting at 3:30 PM CT on Tuesday, June 2nd.
​
Traders who voluntarily add a Daily Loss Limit to their account unlock double per-request payout caps. No DLL added = current caps remain unchanged.

Limited Time Offering: Payout Cap Increase FAQs
Is this available for all Traders?
Yes! All Traders who make a new Trading Combine purchase and add a Daily Loss Limit (DLL) at checkout will receive the increased Payout cap, during this limited time offering beginning at 3:30 PM CT on Tuesday, June 2nd.
​
​ Why is this a limited-time offering, and how long will this last?
We're always looking for new ways to reward responsible trading — this is one of them. Keep an eye on our social channels to find out when this offer will expire and what is coming up next.
If I add a DLL at checkout during Express Funded Account activation or Reactivation, will I still get the increased Payout cap?
No. Only if you already added the DLL when you purchased your Trading Combine. Adding it at the XFA stage doesn't unlock the higher cap.
If I already added a Daily Loss Limit before this release, will I see an increased Payout cap?
No — the increased cap is only available on new Trading Combine purchases. That said, the DLL still protects you. 63% of Traders lost their Combine on day 1. It's worth having.
Does this apply to both Trading Combine paths?
Yes — Standard and Consistency both qualify.
Express Funded Account Standard
To request a Payout, you must meet both requirements:
5 winning days of $150+ Net P&L. Days don't need to be consecutive. A day locks in at 4:00 PM CT. The trading day your Payout is requested doesn't count toward your next 5.
Positive net profit since your last Payout. You must have earned at least $0.01 since your last Payout. Your first Payout is exempt.
After each Payout: Your Maximum Loss Limit (MLL) resets to $0 permanently, and your 5-day count restarts.

Express Funded Account Consistency
To request a Payout, you must meet both requirements:
3 trading days with at least 1 trade per day.
Stay at or below the 40% Consistency Objective. Your largest single day cannot exceed 40% of your total net profit. Days lock in at 4:00 PM CT. The trading day your Payout is requested doesn't count toward your next 3. For example, if your best trading day’s profit is $2,000, your total net profit must be at least $5,000 ($2,000 ÷ 0.4). This ensures that profits are distributed across multiple trading days, promoting consistent trading behavior.
After each Payout: Your Maximum Loss Limit resets to $0 permanently, your consistency calculation resets, and your 3-day count restarts.
Live Funded Account
5 winning days of $150+ Net P&L per Payout cycle (not consecutive)
Request up to 50% of your account balance with no dollar cap
After you request a Payout, your winning day count restarts. You'll need 5 new winning days before you're eligible to request your next Payout.
Daily Payouts (after 30 winning days in the LFA):
Once you've earned $150+ Net P&L on 30 non-consecutive days in your Live Funded Account, you unlock daily Payouts — request as much of your unlocked balance as you want, once per day (min $125). Winning days from the XFA do not count toward this total.
Note: Requesting a full 100% Payout closes your LFA since the balance reaches the Maximum Loss Limit.

Prop-to-Brokerage Payouts
Earned a prop Payout? U.S. Topstep Prop Traders can direct eligible Payouts to their Topstep Brokerage account – same day, if requested by 12 PM CT.
Aeropay Payouts
Aeropay is a Pay by Bank service for U.S. domestic Traders. Link your bank account and receive approved Payouts directly, with real-time payment processing after approval.
Instant payments are subject to your bank's support of real-time transactions. If your bank doesn't support it, funds may take 1-3 business days.
How do I link my bank account? In your Topstep Dashboard, select Aeropay as your Payout method. You'll be redirected to Aeropay's proprietary bank-link flow and authenticate through Aerosync.
Is my banking information secure? Yes. The setup uses Aerosync's authentication flow and data encryption. No banking credentials are stored in Topstep's system.
A few things to note:
Instant payments are available for XFA Payouts through Aeropay Real-time Payments (RTP).
Available to U.S.-based Traders with a U.S.-based bank that supports real-time payments. Check participating institutions here .
Not all Aeropay Payouts deliver instantly — processing times may vary depending on review and approval steps.
Proof of Payout
Want to show off a Payout? We've got you covered with Proof of Payout (POP) Cards.
A POP Card is a downloadable image that generates automatically in the My Payouts tab of your Topstep dashboard once a Payout is completed. POP Cards are available for all Payouts going back to January 1, 2026.
​
Stacked POP Cards
A Stacked POP Card combines all Payouts from the same day into a single downloadable, shareable card. Cards are generated for a Trader's top 6 highest-earning days, going back to January 1, 2026.
​
FAQs
What does Topstep review before approving a Payout?
Payout Policy requirements (outlined above)
Prohibited Conduct , Terms of Use , and Professional Behavior
Prohibited Trading Strategies
What tax forms are required?
W-9 for US persons, W-8BEN for non-US persons. Submitted as part of the Payout request process.
Can my Payout go to a third-party bank account?
No. Payouts can only be sent to a bank account in your own name.
Can I get a bank verification letter from Topstep?
No. You can provide your bank with a copy of your Express Funded Account Agreement instead.
What does "RA" mean in Payout references?
RA stands for Research Analyst, the designation Topstep uses for Traders operating in the simulated environment.
Which countries can't receive Payouts?
See the full Eligibility Requirements list. Review before purchasing a Trading Combine.
How do Payouts affect my Scaling Plan?
If a Payout reduces your balance to a lower tier, your maximum contract size decreases accordingly. See the Scaling Plan .
How do Payouts affect my Maximum Loss Limit?
Your MLL is set to $0 after your first Payout. If it's already at $0, it stays there. The remaining balance becomes your effective loss floor.
Can my account move up or down between Payouts?
Yes. Your account can move up or down as you trade and take Payouts. You just need to be profitable ($.01 or more) since your last Payout before you can request the next one.
I hit the Daily Loss Limit, can I still request a Payout?
Yes — but not yet. Hitting the Daily Loss Limit puts your account in a Temporary Violation. It lifts at the start of the next trading session. Once it clears, you can request a Payout as long as you've met the Payout Policy requirements. The same goes for any personal Lock-outs you've set in Risk Settings.
How does trading impact my Payout request while it is being processed?
Once you request a Payout, the funds are transferred immediately, allowing you to start trading again right away. However, please keep in mind the Payout processing times to determine which trading day will not count toward winning day objectives.
Live Accounts: Please note that after submitting a Payout request, trading should be paused until the Payout has been fully processed and the funds have been deducted from the account.
Will I still get my Payout if I hit the MLL after requesting?
Yes. Once the Payout amount has been deducted from your balance, hitting the MLL won't affect it.
What happens to copy trading during a Payout?
Your copy-trading connection is automatically disabled while a Payout processes. Once the deduction is complete and your balance updates, you must manually re-enable it.
How do Payouts work across multiple XFAs?
Each XFA follows its own Payout Policy independently. Requests from one account don't affect another.
Does profit from the previous cycle carry over?
Profits from the previous cycle remain in your account balance but do not count toward the new cycle’s Consistency Objective calculation.
When should I start taking Payouts?
We recommend reaching a balance where your MLL is at $0 first. This gives your account a healthier base. MLL levels by account size:
Account Size

$50K

$100K

What is the $5K Payout Club and how does it work?
Once you reach $5K in lifetime Payouts across all accounts, you'll be eligible to purchase the exclusive $5K Payout Club hat. You'll receive an email with a link to purchase. This is an optional offer for qualifying Traders!
Please note: the trading day your Payout is requested will not count toward your winning days for the next Payout cycle. The trading day runs from 5:00 PM CT to 3:10 PM CT the following day. A request submitted after 5:00 PM CT belongs to the next trading day — that day becomes the Payout request day and is excluded from the new cycle. This applies to all account types.
​
Example: A Payout request submitted at 5:59 PM CT on Monday belongs to the Tuesday trading session. Tuesday is the Payout request day and does not count. The new cycle begins on Wednesday.

pages.title: Trading Combine® Parameters
pages.content:
Overview
The Trading Combine® is a simulated account where you prove your trading ability without risking your own capital. Follow 1 rule, hit 2 objectives, and you earn an Express Funded Account® (XFA) .
Rule
Do not let your account balance hit or go below the Maximum Loss Limit (MLL)
Objectives
Reach and maintain your Profit Target
Meet the Consistency Target
Parameters at a glance
Parameter
| $50K
| $100K
| $150K
Starting Balance
| $50,000
| $100,000
| $150,000
Profit Target
| $3,000
| $6,000
| $9,000
Maximum Loss Limit
| $2,000
| $3,000
| $4,500
Consistency Target
| 55% of Profit Target
| 55% of Profit Target
| 55% of Profit Target
Best Day Recommendation
| Less than $1,650
| Less than $3,300
| Less than $4,950
Maximum Position Size
| 5 mini / 50 micro
| 10 mini / 100 micro

| $1,000

Minimum trading days
| 2
| 2
| 2
Time limit to pass
| None
| None
| None
Parameters in Depth
Profit Target
The net profit you need to make in order to pass
You can't hit it in 1 day. The Consistency Target applies.
Example: $50K account, $3,000 Profit Target. Earn $3,000 and your balance is $53,000.
Maximum Loss Limit
The lowest your account balance can go. It cannot be adjusted.
It trails up with your end-of-day balance, never down. Once it reaches your starting balance, it locks permanently.
Touch it at any point, even on unrealized P&L, and your account is liquidated for the rest of the trading day.
Your account is ineligible for funding until you Reset . You can still practice trade.
Example: $50K account, $50,000 balance, $48,000 MLL. Make $500 and the MLL moves to $48,500.
Consistency Target
Your best single day must stay below 55% of your Profit Target. Stay below the Best Day Recommendation in the table above.
Go over and your Profit Target increases. You need to earn more to pass.
Losses do not reset your best day.
Your best day locks in at 3:10 PM CT.
Example: $50K account, $3,000 Profit Target. A $2,200 best day raises it to $4,000.
See Consistency at Topstep for the full rules.
Maximum Position Size
The maximum number of contracts you can hold open at one time, per account
Minis and micros share the same limit at a 10:1 ratio. 1 mini = 10 micros.
Example: $50K account, 5 mini limit. Hold 2 minis and you have room for 30 micros.
Hint: You're never required to trade the maximum. Fewer contracts is always allowed.
Position limits can tighten temporarily during high volatility and Tier 1 News Events. See Risk Adjustments: High Risk/High Volatility .
⚠️ Please note: The Micro to Mini ratio functionality is available for the Trading Combine and Express Funded Account. It is not currently available for the Live Funded Account® (LFA).
Daily Loss Limit
Optional. Add it at checkout when you purchase a Trading Combine.
It's fixed at purchase and can't be changed later. It carries into your XFA.
Hit it and open positions are flattened, pending orders are canceled, and no new trades are allowed until 5 PM CT.
It is not a rule violation. Your account stays eligible for funding.
No Daily Loss Limit at purchase? You can set a Personal Daily Loss Limit in Risk Settings. It can be adjusted or removed.
See Daily Loss Limit for details.
Trading Hours and Products
Topstep is a day trading program. No swing trading. Futures only.
The trading day runs from 5:00 PM CT to 3:10 PM CT the next calendar day. All positions must be closed by 3:10 PM CT.
Avoid opening new positions after 3:08 PM CT. Risk Managers begin flattening then.
Friday closes at 3:10 PM CT and reopens Sunday at 5:00 PM CT.
Some products close earlier. See When and What Products Can I Trade?
FAQs
Can I have more than one Trading Combine?
Yes. There's no limit to the number of Trading Combines you can have.
If you have multiple accounts, double-check which one you're trading on before you start. Topstep isn't responsible for trades made on the wrong account.
⚠️ Single Profile Policy:
All Trading Combines, Express Funded Accounts, and Live Funded Accounts must be under 1 Topstep profile.
Multiple profiles are a Terms of Use violation and can result in account closure or suspension.
If you've accidentally created a second profile, contact Trader Support .
To update your name or email, follow these steps instead .
Do I need to purchase a data subscription?
No. Level 1 (Top of Book) live data is included in your Topstep membership at no extra cost. Level 2 (Depth of Market) is available as an upgrade for DOM or Ladder traders. See Level 1 and Level 2 Market Data for details.
Can I pass the Trading Combine in one day?
No. Big spike days don't build funded traders, consistency does. You can pass in as few as two days, but keep your best day below 55% of your Profit Target.
What happens after I pass?
What happens after I pass?
When a 50K, 100K, or 150K Trading Combine® (account prefix: 50KTC, 100KTC, or 150KTC) passes, the account closes and the subscription is canceled. You'll receive a confirmation email and can activate your Express Funded Account® directly from your Dashboard. See step-by-step activation instructions here .
​
​ Please note: The status update can take up to 30 minutes. If it still shows Active after 30 minutes, verify your Consistency Target has been met.
👉 A few things to keep in mind:
Passed on a Friday? You can pay the Activation Fee immediately, but your XFA won't be available to trade until markets reopen at 5 PM CT Sunday.
Trading day hours: The trading day runs from 5:00 PM CT through 3:10 PM CT the next calendar day. Trades placed after 5:00 PM CT (e.g., 6:30 PM CT Tuesday) count toward Wednesday's activity.
Profits don't transfer. Money made in the Trading Combine does not carry over to your Express Funded Account.
Can I change my account size?
No. Account sizes can't be changed after purchase. If your purchase was made within the last 28 days and your account has had no trading activity, contact Trader Support to review your account for a refund so you can purchase the correct size. After 28 days or if any trading has occurred, refunds are not available.
Can I use automated trading strategies?
Yes, with conditions. Topstep won't help set up or troubleshoot automated strategies, and no exceptions are made for errant trades or malfunctions. Test on your Practice Account first and review Prohibited Conduct and Prohibited Trading Strategies before going live. You can also use a trade copier to duplicate trades across multiple accounts.
