pages.title: TopstepX™
pages.content:
The Basics
TopstepX™ is Topstep’s trading platform built for execution, risk management, and performance tracking. Access it at topstepx.com/trade or directly from your Dashboard.
​
Click here to access TopstepX™. Your login credentials are the same as those you use to access your Topstep Dashboard.
👉 Heads up! Starting November 12, 2026, your login credentials for TopstepX and the Topstep Dashboard will be the same.
Forgot your password? Reset it here !
Using your old login? You'll see an error message directing you to your Dashboard credentials.
Google and Facebook sign-in will still work if they're connected to your Dashboard account.
Have questions? Contact Support .
You can also launch TopstepX right from your dashboard!
Once you are logged into TopstepX™, you are ready to trade! Just be sure to select your account in the top left!
TopstepX Features
TopstepX Features: Select each feature drop-down below to learn more!
Account Nicknames
Account Nicknames
Give your accounts names so you don't trade the wrong one.
Click the pencil icon next to any account in the dropdown → enter nickname → Save
Works on all account types
Max 30 characters
Resets clear nicknames — new account number, fresh slate
Nicknames aren't visible to Trader Support — always provide your original account number
Alerts
Alerts
Turn Sound Alerts and Visual Alerts on or off.
Setup: Settings → Misc → Alerts → toggle Sound Alerts and/or Visual Alerts.
Balances Font Size
Balances Font Size
Adjust the font size of the balances shown in your header.
Setup: Settings → Misc → Balances Font Size.
Concurrent Sessions Limit
Concurrent Sessions Limit
Exchange regulations limit your access to one concurrent user session across all devices (PC, mobile, etc.). Logging into a new device will automatically disconnect your previous session.
Note: You can open multiple browser windows or tabs simultaneously, provided they are all running on the same device and using the same browser version.
Contract Rollover
Contract Rollover
TopstepX auto-updates every futures product to the current front month — no need to track rollover dates or volume yourself.
Contracts are automatically rolled over during the daily market close window (4:00 PM – 5:00 PM CST) based on an internal algorithm to determine the optimal time to roll active contracts prior to the next trading day based on volume, open interest, and expiration dates.
Custom Layouts
Custom Layouts
Drag any component's header to rearrange your workspace. A yellow guide arrow shows where it'll land.
Adjust your layout → "draft" appears next to the layout name.
Click Save Layout to keep changes, or Save as New Layout to create a new one.
Reset Layout restores the default setup.
Delete Layout removes a saved layout you don't need anymore.
Multiple windows: Pop out multiple windows by clicking the double-square icon in the top-right corner. Once a new window or tab opens, you can maximize individual components (Chart, DOM, Quotes, etc.) by clicking the square icon in the top-right corner of that section. There is no limit to the number of windows you can have open at once.
👉 Important: Exchange rules limit you to 1 device/browser at a time — you cannot have it open simultaneously on a PC and a phone, on two different computers, or on two different browsers (like Chrome and Edge) at the same time. You are permitted to have multiple tabs or windows open at once on a single browser.
Extended and Regular Trading Hours Toggle
Extended and Regular Trading Hours Toggle
Switch between ETH and RTH charts for better context.
Extended Trading Hours ( ETH) — near 24-hour coverage. Lower liquidity. More volatile.
Regular Trading Hours ( RTH) — higher participation. Better liquidity. More stable price action.
Useful for gap trading, breakout analysis, and volume profile work.
Exporting Trades
Exporting Trades
Exporting your trades is a powerful way to review performance, refine strategies, manage risk, and better understand your trading habits.
How to Export Your Trades
Click the Orders or Trades tab at the bottom of the page.
Click "Export."
Select your desired date range and click "Export."
A confirmation will appear at the bottom-left of your screen once complete.
From there, upload your file to Excel, Google Sheets, or any program you prefer.
Hotkeys
Hotkeys
Keyboard shortcuts for faster execution. Fewer clicks. Fewer errors.
Setup:
Settings gear → Hotkeys
Click Set Hotkey next to the action you want
Press your key(s) → Confirm
Press H on the DOM or Orderbook to enable
Not set by default — configure your own
Desktop only — not supported on mobile
Avoid system-reserved keys (e.g., CTRL+R reloads the page)
Practice in a Practice Account first
Pressing a hotkey triggers that action across all active components where hotkeys are enabled. For example: if hotkeys are enabled across multiple order panels with different symbols selected, pressing the hotkey executes a market buy for each symbol.
Performance Dashboard
Performance Dashboard
Real-time view of your trading activity. Desktop only. Available for Practice, Trading Combine, and Express Funded Accounts.
Access: Performance Stats tab on the left.
Includes:
Balance High/Current/Low, Best Day %, Avg Win/Loss, Best/Worst Trade, Win Rate, Long vs. Short %, Weekly/Monthly P&L
Trade Log with full entry/exit detail
Trader Journal — log emotions, notes, observations
Calendar with Daily P&L
Social Sharing
Stats update as trades complete. Multiple tabs open? Refresh the performance page after each trade.
Price Alerts
Price Alerts
Price Alerts on TopstepX™ allow you to track key market levels and receive instant notifications when your targets are met. Learn more here !
Track Your Preferred Products
Track Your Preferred Products
Starred products move to the top of the dropdown.
No traditional watchlist. Use favorites instead:
Open the Order Ticket or DOM
Click the Contract dropdown
Star ⭐ your preferred products
Starred products move to the top of the dropdown.
Trade Copier
Trade Copier
The Trade Copier lets you mirror trades from a Lead account to 1 or more Follower accounts automatically — so you can run the same strategy across multiple accounts without placing every order manually.
Lead account — where you place your trades
Follower account(s) — where those trades are copied to
✋ Before you connect accounts, please know:
The Lead account must have the lowest Maximum Position Size (MPS) of all accounts in the group. Running a 50K, 100K, and 150K? The 50K is your Lead.
If your Lead and Follower accounts are at different Scaling Plan tiers — meaning their margin requirements differ — the Trade Copier may disconnect automatically at the start of a new trading day. Always verify your copy trading settings at the start of each session.
Trade copying is only available for Trading Combine® and Express Funded Account® accounts. Live Funded Account® accounts cannot use the Trade Copier.
Filled orders on Follower accounts only appear in the Order Log after they're filled — not when placed.
While a Follower account is connected, you can't trade it directly. If the order buttons are greyed out, the account is still linked. Remove it in Settings to trade it independently.
Executions are mirrored — but exact fill price and timing may vary slightly due to slippage, liquidity, and market conditions.
Turning off the Trade Copier mid-trade will immediately flatten all Follower accounts.
Only one Trade Copier group (one Lead and its Followers) can be set up at a time. Setting up a new group replaces the previous one.
Linking / Unlinking
If the Lead hits its Daily Loss Limit or is auto-liquidated, all Follower accounts are flattened with it and no further trades copy while the Lead is locked out. The accounts stay linked — copying resumes when the Lead can trade again. You may unlink the accounts manually to trade the followers separately.
If the Lead hits its Maximum Loss Limit, the account is permanently violated; unlink the Followers in Settings to trade them independently.
If you select Liquidate Only when setting your PDLL/PDPT , when one of these violations fires on a follower, that account does get dropped from the copier before it's flattened.
If you select Liquidate and Block when setting your PDLL/PDPT , when one of these violations fires on a follower, the account is locked out. It auto-resumes the next trading and does not get removed from Trade Copier.
If the Scaling plan does not match between the Leader and followers - follower account will be automatically removed at the start of the trading day
When a Payout request is submitted, Follower accounts are automatically unlinked. Check your settings at the start of every session.
⚠️ Important: Please read more about how copy trading can affect potential for hedging here .
Risk Settings for Follower Accounts
Follower accounts support a Personal Daily Loss Limit (PDLL) and/or Personal Daily Profit Target (PDPT). Trade Limits, Symbol Blocks, and Contract Limits are not available on Follower accounts.
Where to find Settings: In TopstepX, Settings is the gear icon on the left side of the screen.
Setting Up the Trade Copier
Go to Settings → Copy Trading .
Select your Lead account and check your Follower accounts .
Click Save Changes .
Turning Off the Trade Copier
Go to Settings → Copy Trading .
Click Clear → Save Changes .
Adding or Removing Follower Accounts
Go to Settings → Copy Trading .
Check or uncheck accounts under Follow → Save Changes .
Using the Trade Copier on Mobile
Open TopstepX in your mobile browser.
Tap 3 dots → Trading → Copy Trading .
Select your Lead, check your Followers, tap Save Changes .
Trader Hub
Trader Hub
Real-time market news and economic events, powered by Financial Juice.
Market News Feed — Up-to-date, real-time breaking news and market developments.
Economic Events Calendar — A live global schedule shown in your PC's time zone.
Data Columns: Shows the Time/Date , the Actual observed result, the Forecast (analyst estimates), and the Previous reported value.
Impact Levels: Events are color-coded by market impact: Red (High), Orange (Medium), and Yellow (Low).
⚠️ Important: High-impact news events bring volatility — wider spreads, fast price swings, and slippage. Trade around them carefully.
Trading Tones
Trading Tones (Custom Audio Notifications)
Upload custom sounds for key platform events.
​
Where: Settings → Misc → Custom Sounds
​
Supported events: Order Filled, TP/SL, Order Rejected, Market Open/Close, Order Cancelled, Position Closed (ITM/OTM), PDLL, MLL, DLL, PDPT
​
File requirements: Max 3 MB — .mp3, .wav, .ogg, .m4a, .webm
Preview, replace, or delete sounds anytime. Desktop settings carry over to mobile if audio is enabled on your device.
How to upload a Trading Tone
Find the notification you want to customize
Click the Upload icon next to it
Select your custom audio file from your local computer
Click Upload to apply the sound
Important Notes
Audio uploads are account-specific and not visible to other traders
Desktop audio settings carry over to mobile if mobile audio is enabled
Some notifications are new and not included in Hoag's audio pack — only a default sound is available until you upload a custom file
TopstepX Order Management
TopstepX Order Management: Select each feature drop-down below to learn more!
Position Risk / Profit Brackets
Adding Position Risk / Profit Brackets to your TopstepX Orders & Positions
Designed to help Traders stay disciplined. Attach predefined stop-loss and take-profit levels to every position automatically. Set at the account level — different accounts can run different strategies.
👉 Important: The minimum distance Position Brackets can be placed is 4 ticks from the entry price. If you enter a dollar value for your risk and profit amounts that would make your Position Brackets less than 4 ticks from the entry price, TopstepX will default your Position Brackets 4 ticks away automatically.
Setup:
Settings → Risk Settings tab
Account Settings → Brackets
Toggle Position Risk / Profit Brackets ON → enter Risk and Profit dollar amounts
Save
Adjust an active trade by dragging the P&L bar directly.
Auto-OCO Brackets
Auto-OCO Brackets
Every entry gets its own take-profit and stop-loss — no manual placement needed. (OCO = One Cancels Other)
When one fills, the other cancels automatically
Brackets apply per entry, not across the full position
Must be flat to enable or switch bracket types
Using the DOM? OCO must also be enabled there.
Setup: Settings → Risk Settings → Switch to Auto-OCO → set values → Save.
​
Enable Auto-OCO brackets directly on the specific interface(s) you trade from, whether that is the Chart, Order Panel, DOM, or a combination of them.
👉 Important: If you use ticks, TopstepX requires you to enter a value greater than 5 ticks. If you use a dollar value, TopstepX will reject your orders if the dollar value entered does not place your brackets at least 4 ticks away from the entry price.
Charting
Charting
TopstepX supports up to 8 charts on a single screen, each defaulting to /ES. Leave charts unlinked for independent operation, or use Symbol Link (color-coded) to keep them in sync.
Chart Types
TopstepX supports 16 chart types — Bars, Candles, Hollow Candles, Line, Line with Markers, Step Line, Area, HLC Area, Baseline, Columns, High-Low, Heikin Ashi, Renko, Line Break, Kagi, and Point & Figure. Change type and timeframe from the dropdowns in the chart's top-left corner. To set a custom timeframe, click the chart and type your interval — only listed timeframes are valid.
Symbol & Component Linking
Linking syncs a symbol change across all components (charts, DOM) assigned the same color. Click the link icon in any component header to assign a color. For charts, click "Add Chart Link" while the chart is active.
Chart Executions
Displays trade entries and exits directly on your charts. Useful for identifying patterns, reviewing decision-making, and journaling trades. All entry/exit points stack and remain visible even on larger candles. Disabled by default.
To enable: Settings → Charts & Data → toggle "Show Chart Executions" → Save
Place an order — right-click at your price and pick the order type
Modify a working order — click and drag it to a new price
Add a Take Profit / Stop Loss — click your position indicator and drag up or down to set a TP or SL bracket. Modify the same way
Cancel an order — click the "X" next to the working order
Change symbol — click the current symbol and search, or click the chart and type the symbol directly
Chart Value Display
TopstepX supports up to 8 charts on a single screen, each defaulting to /ES. Leave charts unlinked for independent operation, or use Symbol Link (color-coded) to keep them in sync.
Important:
Cannot connect to external platforms like TradingView; custom indicators are not available due to TradingView's commercial licensing terms.
Available timeframes: 1m, 2m, 3m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1D, 1W, 1M (no 10m)
Charts load up to 1 year back.
Countdown to Bar Close
This setting is a countdown indicator that displays the time remaining until each selected bar closes. You can navigate to the Scale Settings by either right clicking on chart scale or by accessing the Chart Settings and checking "Countdown to bar close". Note: this setting does not work on Tick charts.
Chart Drawing Tools
Using TradingView's drawing tools, you can annotate, comment, highlight trends and patterns, measure and forecast, and calculate price levels Double-click a tool for style and visibility settings, or save a style as a template.
Favorite a tool — star it in the dropdown menu for quick access on a floating panel
Hide all drawings — click "Hide All Drawing Tools" in the left toolbar
Snap to price — enable Magnet Mode (click the Magnet tool, or hold CTRL/Command while drawing) to snap drawings to the nearest OHLC price on a bar
Copy chart style: Click "Apply to all" in Chart Settings to copy 1 chart's timeframe, indicators, and look/feel across every chart in your layout.
News Events
TopstepX auto-plots high-impact news events directly on your charts — click a marker to see the event. Right-click the chart and select "Hide Marks on Bars" to remove them.
Chart Display Settings
Chart Value Display Type — show order/position values in Dollar value, Ticks, Percent, or Points
Hide Economic Events — hides economic news plots from your charts
Hide Chart Plots / Chart Plot Alignment — additional display controls under Settings → Charts & Data
NEW: Range Bars
Range Bars
👉 Let price — not the clock — decide when a bar prints, so trends, consolidation, and breakouts stand out without the noise of time-based charts.
What it shows
Each Range Bar represents a fixed price move instead of a fixed slice of time. A new bar prints only when price travels your chosen range (say, 10 ticks) — no move, no new bar, no matter how much time passes. Quiet stretches compress into a few bars; strong moves stretch into a long run of them.
How do I add Range Bars? Range Bars live inside the Advanced Charts (Beta) component. Press the plus sign to add a component, then drag Advanced Charts (Beta) into your layout.
What you'll see
Long run of same-color bars — a real trend, completing bars quickly.
Alternating bars in a tight zone — consolidation. Price isn't committing to a direction.
Bars printing faster — volatility is rising, common around news or the session open.
Bars slowing down — price has stalled.
A clean break from a tight cluster — a shift from balance to directional bars.
Trendlines, channels, and support/resistance tend to line up more consistently than on a time chart.
Where it fits
Range Bars work on any futures contract, on intraday charts. Range size is adjustable per instrument, since a fixed tick count behaves differently across contracts.
👉 Please note: Range Bars have been launched in Beta as a real-time chart type. Bars build forward from when you open the chart — you can't scroll back to bars that printed before, and reloading or switching symbols starts the build fresh. Historical data (rebuilding past bars from tick history) is planned for a future release.
Range Bars FAQs
​ Why does my data reset?
Beta data resets daily, on top of any reload, symbol switch, or connection drop.
Can I customize my settings?
Yes. At launch you can choose from 4 chart types and 7 ranges (plus a custom range), and you can change bar color, line color, and timezone.
Can I link my chart?
Yes, using the link control in the top-left corner of the component.
Can I add indicators to Advanced Charts?
Not at this time. Because it's a custom chart, a number of things aren't available yet, including indicators, drawing tools, and right-click to place chart orders.
How do I sync the crosshairs from my main chart?
You can't. Crosshair syncing between your main chart and Advanced Charts isn't supported.
Order Management Overview
Types of Orders
Order Type
| Description
Market Order
| Filled immediately at the current market price
Limit Order
| Filled at a specific price you set
Stop Market Order
| Pending until conditions are met; used to limit losses or enter after a confirmed directional move
OCO (One Cancels the Other)
| 2 linked orders — when 1 executes, the other cancels automatically
Trailing Stop Order
| A stop that trails the market in set increments as price moves away
Filled Order
| An order that has been executed
Open/Pending Order
| An order waiting to be filled
Risk (Stop)
| Amount (USD) you're willing to lose on a position. Position closes when reached; updates as size changes
To Make (Take Profit)
| Amount (USD) you want to gain on a position. Position closes when reached; updates as size changes
Learn more about Order Types here .
​
Order Ticket
Select Buy or Sell, pick your order type (Market, Limit, Stop Market, Trailing Stop, or OCO), and access Cancel All, Flatten All, and Reverse Position.
Time & Sales
A live feed of all trading activity for your selected product. To filter by minimum trade size, go to System Settings.
DOM (Depth of Market)
The DOM (also called the ladder) displays market depth, volume profile, and price levels for one-click trading.
Left-click Bid or Ask → Limit Order
Right-click Bid or Ask → Stop Order
Hover, click, and drag existing orders to move them to a new level
Active positions appear highlighted in blue with theoretical P&L updating as your position size changes.
​ Column Breakdown:
​ Price — Available market price levels
​
​ Bid / Ask Size — how many contracts buyers/sellers want at each level
​
​ Volume Profile — Total traded volume per price level, useful for spotting support/resistance
​
​ My Bid / My Ask — Shows your working orders (Limits, Stops, Take Profits)
​
​ Market Data — TopstepX shows the Explicit Book — real orders traders have actually placed, not an Implied Book of synthetic, system-generated orders.
Level 1 (Top of Book) — Default view, shows only the best bid and best ask.
Level 2 (Full DOM) — Displays full market depth across multiple price levels.
DOM Settings — Customize the DOM's look and layout from the gear icon at the top of the DOM.
Fixed-width Bid/Ask volumes
Hide Join Bid/Ask, Reverse Position, Flatten All, Close ---Position, Cancel Order, or Cancel All buttons
Hide the ---P&L or Volume Profile column
Always show My Ask / My Bid
Bid/Ask background color, font size, and row padding
☝️ TopstepX supports 1 window at a time — the DOM cannot be moved to a secondary screen. If you place orders from the DOM, make sure OCO Brackets are enabled there. If OCO is off in the DOM, Auto-OCO Brackets won't apply — even if enabled in Risk Settings.
Trading Activity
The bottom panel breaks down your account and activity:
Accounts — All active accounts in one place
Positions — View or close open positions; edit Risk (Stop) and To Make (Take Profit) in USD
Orders — All completed and open orders for the day; cancel any pending orders
Trades — All completed round-trip positions
Quotes — Current market conditions for all available futures products
Order Confirmations
To enable: Settings → Charts & Data → Order Settings → Show Confirmations → Save
TopstepX Risk Settings
TopstepX Risk Settings: Select each feature drop-down below to learn more!
Contract Limits
Contract Limits
Cap the number of contracts you can trade per symbol.
Orders exceeding the limit are automatically rejected
Applies to order entry only — won't close open positions
Take Profit and Stop Loss bracket orders are ignored
Enforced separately for long and short
Setup: Settings → Risk Settings → Contract Limits → enter limits → Save.
​
​ This is also where you can see current contract limits according to your account type/size.
​
Trade Limits
Trade Limits
Cap total trades per day and/or week.
Open positions can still be managed
Every entry and exit counts as a trade
Once the limit is hit, no new trades
Trade limits do NOT auto-close open positions
Setup: Settings → Risk Settings → Trade Limits → enter max daily/weekly → Save.
Trade Limits allow you to set a maximum number of trades you can take per day and/or week.
⚠️ Important: Any pending orders placed prior to hitting the limit must be manually cancelled. TopstepX will not automatically remove pre-existing pending orders upon a trade limit lockout.
Daily Risk Lock
Daily Risk Lock
Lock your risk settings for the day. Covers PDLL, PDPT, and Trade Limits.
Can't be changed until the next trading day
Unlocks at 5 PM CT
Support cannot reverse a lock once applied
Setup: Settings → Risk Settings → set limits → Save → Lock Risk Settings for Day → Confirm.
Scheduled Lockouts: NEW!
​ Scheduled Lockouts
Block yourself from trading on a schedule. Set a repeating lockout so you don’t have to reset it every day, or set a one-time lockout for later today. Per account, so set it separately for each.
| Repeating
| One-time
How it works
| Runs on the days you pick
| Runs once later today, then disappears
What you set
| Start time, end time, and days (M, Tu, W, Th, F, Su)
| Start time and end time
Notes
| No Saturday
| No date picker. Can’t be set for a future day
Overnight: an end time earlier than the start runs into the next day. Max window is 24 hours.
Presets: New York, London, Tokyo, and Sydney start Inactive. Press play and confirm to turn one on.
Works like a manual lockout. Positions flatten, working orders cancel, new orders are blocked, and copy trading followers exit.
Runs whether or not you’re logged in. Unlocks at the end time.
Once it starts, it can’t be ended, shortened, paused, or deleted. Support can’t either.
Setup: Platform Settings → Risk Settings → Trading Controls → Scheduled Lockouts. A schedule saves when you click Continue.
Preset
| Window (CT)
New York
| 8:30 a.m. to 4 p.m.
London
| 2 a.m. to 8:30 a.m.
Tokyo
| 5 p.m. to 2 a.m.
Changing a schedule
Action
| What happens
Edit
| Right away before the start. Next trading day after.
Pause
| Stops it from the next trading day. Today’s lockout still runs.
Skip next lockout
| Skips 1 occurrence. Schedule stays active.
Delete
| Gone right away before the start. If running, removed from the next trading day.
Personal Daily Profit Target/Daily Loss Limit
Personal Daily Profit Target/Daily Loss Limit
The Personal Daily Profit Target (PDPT) and Personal Daily Loss Limit (PDLL) are optional risk settings in TopstepX that allow you to define daily profit and loss thresholds. Learn more about the PDLL here .
Setup: Settings → Risk Settings → enter limits → choose action → Save.
When a threshold is hit, your account responds based on the action you selected. Final outcome depends on market volatility, slippage, and contracts being exited at the time.
Trailing Personal Daily Loss Limit (TPDLL)
The TPDLL is an advanced risk management tool that allows Traders to set a loss limit that dynamically adjusts based on their highest reached account balance. Once the limit trails up, it never moves back down—locking in gains and managing your risk in real time. Learn more about the TPDLL here .
Copy Trading Behavior
When a threshold is reached while copy trading:
Follower Risk Setting
| Behavior
No PDLL/PDPT set
| Any liquidation or block on the Leader applies to the Follower
PDLL/PDPT + Liquidate
| Follower liquidates and is removed from the copier when its limit is hit
PDLL/PDPT + Liquidate & Block
| Follower liquidates and is blocked for the day; auto-resumes the next trading day unless manually removed
Privacy
Privacy
Hide sensitive numbers from your header if you stream or share your screen. Toggle visibility for:
Balance
Maximum Loss Limit (MLL)
Realized P&L (RP&L)
Unrealized P&L (UP&L)
Daily Loss Limit (DLL)
Setup: Settings → Privacy → toggle Streamer Mode for each value you want hidden.
Symbol Block
Symbol Block
Symbol Block allows you to restrict specific trading symbols, helping you stay focused on the products you trade best and avoid unnecessary risk.
Doesn't close open positions
Doesn't cancel working orders
You must manually remove a symbol to trade it again
Combine Symbol Block with other risk settings (e.g., Trade Limits, Daily Risk Lock)
You can select one or more symbols to block from trading.
Setup: Settings → Risk Settings → Symbol Block → select symbol → Add Block → Save.
Blocked Symbols will appear in your Current Symbol Blocks list. To remove a symbol, click the “X” next to it and save.
Trade Clock
Trade Clock
Pauses new entries without closing open positions or orders. Unlike Lockout — you keep control of your active trades.
Setup: Risk Settings → set duration → Enable Trade Clock.
Can still manage existing trades, adjust stops/targets, and use Flatten All while active.
| Trade Clock
| Lockout
Closes open positions
| No
| Yes
Cancels working orders
| No
| Yes
Prevents new entries
| Yes
| Yes
Manage existing trades
| Yes
| No
The Tilt™
The Tilt™
The Tilt is Topstep's proprietary real-time sentiment indicator showing the long/short positioning of all Funded Traders on TopstepX. It gives you a visual breakdown of buy and sell interest for ES, NQ, CL, and GC — updated every 10 seconds using Express Funded Account data.
How to Access
The Tilt is enabled by default in the bottom panel. If you don't see it, click the "+" icon in the top-right corner and select The Tilt. If it's still missing, use Reset Layout to restore defaults — note this may remove any custom layouts you've saved.
Best Practices
Use alongside technical analysis and risk management — not as a replacement
Reflects Topstep funded trader positioning only, not the broader market
Sentiment shifts quickly; always factor in current market context like news and volatility
Confirm Account Switching
Confirm Account Switching
Ensure you’re trading the right account be turning on Confirm Account Switching .
Settings —> Charts & Data —> Confirm Account Switching
Distance to MLL
Distance to MLL
Swap your header display from your Maximum Loss Limit balance to your distance from it — how much room you have left before you hit it.
Setup: Settings → Misc → toggle Distance to MLL .
General Troubleshooting
If you’re experiencing latency or slow performance:
Lower your Data Speed (Slow or Medium Recommended)
Remove indicators and add them back one at a time
Reduce the number of active indicators
If you’re on mobile, try using another device such as a laptop or desktop
Try another browser or incognito mode
Clear your Cache and Cookies
Use a website to check your connection quality (not speed test) to USA based servers.
⚡️ TopstepX uses real-time exchange data with no artificial delay. On slower machines or Wi-Fi connections, this may impact performance.
Inverted Charts
Inverted Charts
If your chart appears upside down, the Invert Scale setting is likely enabled.
Right-click on the price axis on the right side of the chart
Look for " Invert Scale "
If it is checked, uncheck the option
The chart should return to its normal orientation
Data Feed & Connection
Data Feed & Connection
TopstepX pulls data straight from the exchange(s)— no third-party feed. Data servers sit in Northern Virginia, and every Trader connects there regardless of location for market data.
Pick your refresh speed:
Slow — 750ms
Medium — 250ms (default)
Fast — 50ms
Chart lag does not affect trading and orders — order execution runs server-side, not through your browser. Traders are advised to monitor their Positions tab at all times.
How to Flatten Your Trades
How to Flatten Your Trades
If you want to quickly exit all positions and cancel all working orders, use Flatten All.
This will close all positions and cancel all working orders on the selected account
It does not affect other accounts
Flatten Your Trades
Locate the Flatten All button (available on both the Order Ticket and DOM)
Click Flatten All
Click Confirm
Daily Loss Limit Value Not Showing in Header
If the Daily Loss Limit value isn't visible in your account header, try these steps:
Set your browser zoom to 100% and make sure the window is fully maximized — header values can disappear when the window is too narrow.
Check for a customization or gear option in the header and confirm "Daily Loss Limit" is enabled.
Confirm you have the correct account selected — the header reflects the active account only.
Discord
If you're unable to flatten directly on the platform, you can submit a request through out #get-flat channel in Discord .
Include:
Account number
Platform (TopstepX)
Brief reason for the request
Our team will review and process the request as quickly as possible.
💡 Orders, stops, or take profits not showing on your chart? Check chart linking first. Click the link icon on your chart and confirm it's connected to the account you're actively trading. This is the most common reason orders don't appear visually even when they're executing correctly. Performance troubleshooting (data speed, cache) is a separate issue.
Mobile Devices
TopstepX is mobile-friendly and can be accessed through your phone’s web browser, allowing you to manage trades and monitor the market on the go. Most desktop features are available on mobile, providing a consistent and flexible trading experience.
For the best experience, use a smartphone, and tablets may perform better in desktop mode. Please note there is currently no mobile app. If the mobile version is not loading correctly, ensure that “Desktop Mode” is disabled in your browser settings.
Mobile Navigation
Account Info —View a snapshot of your account balance, UP&L, RP&L, and parameters. Switch between accounts via the dropdown or trigger a Lockout right from this panel — once enabled, it can't be reversed.
All Accounts —Overview of every account tied to your login, including status (Active, Temp. Liquidation, Goal Achieved, or Ineligible), Created On date, Account Name, Win Rate, Total Lots Traded, Day P&L, Open P&L, and Account Balance.
Positions —Monitor open positions in with details on Time, Symbol, Position size, Entry Price, Risk (Stop Loss), To Make (Take Profit), P&L, and a 1-tap Close button.
Orders —Track open, filled, canceled, or rejected orders with key price levels and a quick Cancel option.
Trades —Review your completed round-trip trade history, including Symbol, Size, Time, Entry Price, Exit Price, P&L, and Fees.
Mobile DOM:
Limit Orders — tap Bid Size (buy, below market) or Ask Size (sell, above market)
Stop Market Orders — tap Bid Size (buy, above market) or Ask Size (sell, below market)
Breakeven ("B/E") Order — appears once a position shows a positive unrealized P&L. Tap it to place a Stop Market order at your average entry price
Mobile Charts:
Change symbol — tap the " " near the chart's right edge and pick from the dropdown
TP/SL from chart — tap your position indicator, then drag up or down. A blue-outlined dot shows it's active to move
Order types on mobile charts — Market, Limit, Stop, and Trailing Stop, all accessible from the same " " button
🛜 Important: Because mobile performance depends on your device, Wi-Fi, and data provider, we’re unable to troubleshoot mobile-specific issues that may be related to connectivity.
TopstepX YouTube Videos
TopstepX offers a video library on YouTube with a variety of videos to help you get comfortable with the Platform.
These videos are designed to provide quick, easy-to-follow guidance so you can find the information you need and learn at your own pace. Whether you’re just getting started or diving deeper into specific features, the library is a great place to find the information you’re looking for.
You can access these videos anytime on YouTube .
Related Articles
Topstep Learning
General Platform Troubleshooting
Quantower Connection Instructions

TopstepX™ API Access

pages.title: Dynamic Live Risk Expansion
pages.content:
Topstep's Dynamic Live Risk Expansion adjusts your Daily Loss Limit (DLL) and Maximum Position Size (contract limits) as your Live Funded Account® (LFA) profits grow. Earn your way to more buying power — one tier at a time.
Starting Daily Loss Limit and Maximum Position Size
Account Size
| Starting Daily Loss Limit
| Maximum Position Size
25K

| 3
50K

100K

150K

250K

How Tiers Work
Your net profit determines your Tier. Spend 10 Active Trading Days at each Tier to unlock the next level.
Your Daily Loss Limit increases at end of day after 10 Active Trading Days in the new Tier.
If your net profit falls below your Tier at end of day, your Daily Loss Limit scales down that same day.
If you drop out of a Tier before 10 days, the counter resets when you re-enter it.
You must move one Tier at a time. No skipping.
Active Trading Day: Any day you place at least 1 trade — even a single micro contract. No minimum P/L required.
👉 Important: Only profits made in the Live Funded Account count. Your Express Funded Account® transfer balance and Payouts don't affect your Tier.
Expansion Table
Maximum Position Size
| Profit
| Daily Loss Limit
Up to 100 lots
| 1M
| Up to $100,000
Up to 70 lots
| 550K
| Up to $50,000
Up to 50 lots

Position Limits remain at the max for each account size (5 lots for $50Ks, 10 lots for $100Ks, 15 lots for $150Ks) until the account reaches Tier 4 with with $100K in profit.
For the first three tiers, +$500 is added to your starting Daily Loss Limit for each tier you achieve:
$25K Account (Starts at $1,000 DLL)
$15k Profit -> $1,500 DLL
$20k Profit -> $2,000 DLL
$50k Profit -> $2,500 DLL
$50K Account (Starts at $2,000 DLL):
$15k Profit -> $2,500 DLL
$20k Profit -> $3,000 DLL
$50k Profit -> $3,500 DLL
$100K Account (Starts at $3,000 DLL):
$15k Profit -> $3,500 DLL
$20k Profit -> $4,000 DLL
$50k Profit -> $4,500 DLL
$150K Account (Starts at $4,500 DLL):
$15k Profit -> $5,000 DLL
$20k Profit -> $5,500 DLL
$50k Profit -> $6,000 DLL
$250K Account (Starts at $5,000 DLL):
$15k Profit -> $5,500 DLL
$20k Profit -> $6,000 DLL
$50k Profit -> $6,500 DLL
Once an account reaches $100k in net profit, Daily Loss Limits and Maximum Position Sizes align across all account types (as shown in Tier 4+).
Net Equity Thresholds for Risk Reductions
The Live Team may reduce your Daily Loss Limit and Maximum Position Size if your net equity falls below the thresholds listed here. This can happen even if your account is profitable overall. The review looks at your net equity relative to the threshold, not at whether you are up from where you started. These adjustments are not automatic and are made at Live teams discretion.
​
A reduction to your risk parameters may be considered when the net equity of a Live Funded Account dips below:
$5,000 in a $25k account
$10,000 in a 50K account
$15,000 in a 100K account
$20,000 in a 150K account
$30,000 in a 250k account
Daily Loss Limit Safeguard
Regardless of account size, if your tradable balance drops to lower thresholds, the DLL and Maximum Position Size automatically adjust: ☝️ These limits update on Fridays and return to standard levels once your balance rises back above the thresholds.
Account
| Daily Loss Limit (DLL)
$25K
| $1,000
$50K
| $2,000
$100K
| $3,000
$150K
| $4,500
250K
| $5,000
Regardless of account size:
Tradable balance at or below $10,000 → DLL drops to $2,000, Max Position Size = 5
Tradable balance at or below $5,000 → DLL drops to $1,000, Max Position Size = 3
Example: If you have a 100K Live Funded Account and your end-of-day balance goes below $10,000, your Daily Loss Limit will be changed from $3,000 to $2,000 before the start of the next trading session. The DLL will return to $3,000 after the market closes on Friday if your balance is above $10,000.
This safeguard is designed to limit downside risk during lower-balance periods while allowing traders to continue operating under the same risk framework across all Live account tiers.
Expanded Contract Sizing
Traders who demonstrate consistent performance and account stability may request permission to trade more contracts than standard limits.
This is not automatic. All requests must be reviewed and approved by the Risk Team.
Eligibility:
Tier 4 or higher in the Dynamic Risk Expansion system
Minimum $100,000 balance in your Live Funded Account
Path to Reduction
If your account experiences significant losses from your starting balance, the Risk Team will monitor your performance and may initiate a Shoulder Tap.
Payouts do not count as drawdown. Drawdown is based solely on losses from your Live Funded Account starting balance.
Warning: Reckless or undisciplined trading in a Live Funded Account may result in forfeiture of live capital.
What is a Shoulder Tap?
The term comes from the trading pits — where risk managers would literally tap a struggling Trader on the shoulder during a drawdown to check in and help them refocus.
For more details, see Live Account Call-Up/Call-Down Process .

Trading 101
Whether you're just getting started or sharpening your edge, having the right resources makes all the difference.

Follow Emotions and Find the Money — Andrew Menaker
Gaining Competitive Advantage in the OPM Trading World — Andrew Menaker
Trading with the Cumulative Delta — Peter Davies
Understanding Liquidity and Market Pullbacks — Peter Davies
How to Read a Topstep Purchase Card
Each purchase card shows one Trading Combine® account size with its price, targets, limits, and general parameters. Meet the Targets and don't break the One Rule to earn an Express Funded Account® (XFA).
Label
| What it means
| Example
Buying Power
| The account size. Bigger size, bigger targets and limits.
| $50K Buying Power starts with a $50,000 balance.
Price per month
| Your monthly subscription. Rebills every 30 days until you pass or cancel. The crossed-out price is before the discount.
| $50K: $95 minus the $10 discount = $85/month.
Profit Target
| The net profit you need to make in order to pass. Remember, you can't hit your Profit Target in 1 day. Be sure to review the Consistency Target below.
| $50K: earn $3,000 so your balance is $53,000.
Consistency Target
| Your best day must stay at or below 55% of your Profit Target. Go over and your Profit Target increases. Stay under: $50K: $1,650, $100K: $3,300, $150K: $4,950.
| $50K: a $2,200 best day raises your $3,000 Profit Target to $4,000.
Max Loss Limit (One Rule)
| The lowest your balance can go. It trails up with your end-of-day balance, never down. Touch it, even on unrealized P&L, and you liquidate until you Reset.
| $50K: $50,000 balance, $48,000 limit. Make $500 and it moves to $48,500.
Max Contract Limit
| Also known as your Maximum Position Size. The shows most contracts you can have open at once, per account. Micros and minis count at 10:1. Fewer is always allowed.
| $50K: 5 minis or 50 micros.
Mini
| A Mini is a smaller futures contract that trades electronically. It’s a fraction of the size of a standard futures contract, so it takes less capital and margin to trade.
| Examples of a mini you'll trade in TopstepX include E-mini S&P 500 (ES) and E-mini NASDAQ 100 (NQ).
​
Learn more about what products you can trade here !
Micro
| A Micro is a mini-sized Mini. It tracks the same market at about 1/10 the size, so you get a lower cost to enter and more control over your position size. In TopstepX, 1 Mini = 10 Micros.
| Examples of a micro you'll trade in TopstepX include Micro E-mini S&P (MES) and Micro E-mini NASDAQ 100 (MNQ).
​
Learn more about what products you can trade here !
Daily Loss Limit
| The most you can lose in 1 trading day. Hit it and positions flatten, orders cancel, and no new trades until 5 PM CT. Not a rule violation. Fixed at purchase and carries into your XFA.
| $50K, $1,000 limit: Net P&L hits -$1,000. You're flat and back at 5 PM CT.
DOUBLE Payout Caps
| Doubles your max per-request Payout in the XFA. Automatic when you purchase with the Responsible Trading Advantage , which adds a mandatory Daily Loss Limit. New caps (Standard / Consistency): $50K $4,000 / $6,000, $100K $6,000 / $8,000, $150K $10,000 / $12,000.
| $50K Standard: your $2,000 cap becomes $4,000.
Discount
| Known as the Responsible Trading Advantage. Monthly price drop for adding a Daily Loss Limit to a No Activation Fee Trading Combine. Recurs monthly.
| $100K: $149 minus $20 = $129/month.
Reset Fee
| The cost of a Reset . It sends your Trading Combine back to day 1: balance, Maximum Loss Limit, Consistency Target, and trading days. Limit of 2 per account each day. Pushes your Rebill date out 30 days.
| Your $50K Trading Combine breaches the Maximum Loss Limit. An $85 Reset puts it back at $50,000.
Monthly Reset Credit on Rebill
| Every Rebill adds 1 Reset Credit. Use it instead of paying the Reset Fee. Credits match an account size and type, expire 1 year after they're added, and stay on your profile if you cancel.
| $100K: your Rebill adds a $100K credit. Use it instead of paying $129.
Express Funded Activation Fee
| The fee to activate your XFA after you pass. Free for No Activation Fee Trading Combines. The Standard Path charges $149 per XFA earned.
| $150K: pass, then activate your XFA for $0.
Topstep Trader Lingo
Check out this small but mighty glossary for some of the most common phrases in Futures Trading! 📚
A-H
​ $5K Club — Topstep Traders who have withdrawn $5,000 or more from a funded account.
​ b-Shaped Profile — Market profile pattern dominated by selling; signals long liquidation.
​ Brokers — Intermediaries who execute orders for commissions.
Busting a Trade — Voiding a trade due to errors or exchange rule violations.
Cannonball — Adding to a losing position as it goes against you. Don’t do this.
Contract Size — Number of units in a futures contract (e.g., 1,000 barrels of crude oil).
Covering Shorts — Buying back contracts to close short positions.
Delta (Futures) — Order flow measurement: contracts traded on the offer (positive) minus contracts traded on the bid (negative).
Delta Divergence — Price moving one direction while delta grows in the opposite direction.
DOM (Depth of Market) — A price ladder showing bids and offers at specific prices. Used for execution.
Excess High — A high characterized by a series of single-print profiles.
Excess Low — A low characterized by a series of single-print profiles.
I-Q
​ Fat-Finger — Accidental order entry error (e.g., buying 10 contracts when you meant to buy 1).
FOMC — Federal Open Market Committee. Sets US monetary policy. Learn more .
Flipping the Ticket — Buying when you meant to sell, or vice versa.
Hedge — Offsetting risk with an opposite position in a different market or contract month.
Iceberg — A large resting order that doesn’t disclose its actual size.
Indicator — A math-based tool used to analyze market conditions.
Kerfuffle — Coming to the markets unprepared. Also: a commotion caused by conflicting views.
Liquidating Longs — Selling to realize profits or cut losses on a long position.
Locals — Floor traders who traded for their own account, not as brokers.
Long — Buying a contract with the expectation that price will rise.
Lots / Cars / Contracts — Units of trade. All mean the same thing.
Moron Trade — Adding more to a losing position. Putting “more-on.”
Naked Point of Control (NPOC) — A previous volume point of control that hasn’t been re-tested during regular trading hours.
Open Interest — Total contracts carried over and not closed from previous sessions.
Opening Range — Per Hoag: the first minute of regular trading hours.
P-Shaped Profile — Market profile pattern dominated by buying; signals short covering.
Point of Control (POC) — The most visited price during the previous day’s regular trading hours.
R-Z
​ Regular Trading Hours (RTH) — Old floor pit trading hours. For ES: 8:30 AM – 3:15 PM CT.
Revenge Trade — An impulsive trade taken after a loss to try to “make it back.”
Shoulder Tap — A Risk Manager’s request to address a performance or behavior issue.
Short — Selling a contract with the expectation of buying it back at a lower price.
Short in the Hole — Holding a short position at a bad location (e.g., near the day’s low).
Size — The quantity of contracts traded.
Slippage — Execution at a different price than expected. Common in fast markets. Only occurs with market orders.
Spoofing — Placing fake orders to manipulate other traders. Illegal and prohibited.
Spread — The difference between buy and sell price, or between different products/contract months.
“Spoos” — Slang for E-mini S&P 500 futures (ES). Tracks the S&P 500 Index.
The TILT — The real-time aggregate positions, sentiment, and bias of all Topstep Traders.
Tick — The minimum price increment a contract can move.
Volume — Total number of contracts traded in a session.
Volume Point of Control (VPOC) — The price where the most volume was traded during the previous session.

For a long time, Topstep worked to keep Traders in these countries eligible, going further than many other firms in our industry. We've decided we can no longer offer new accounts there. Eligibility FAQs
I'm Canadian — can I earn a Funded Account?
Yes. You trade on a sub-account of Topstep's master account, considered a US-based account. Many US brokerages don't open Canadian accounts due to regulations — this structure is how it works.
Citizen of an eligible country but living in an ineligible one — can I trade?
No. Residing in an ineligible country makes you ineligible — regardless of citizenship.
Citizen of an ineligible country but living in an eligible one — can I trade?
Possibly. Submit a government-issued photo ID proving permanent residency in the eligible country, plus a bank statement from that country. Topstep's Trust team reviews it. Contact Trader Support →
What if I'm traveling through an ineligible country?
Don't trade while there. Trading from an ineligible country — even briefly — may trigger a review by the Trust team.
Why are some countries XFA-only and not eligible for Live?
Brokerage restrictions prevent Live Funded Account access in certain countries. Those Traders can still earn payouts and build skills in the XFA and Pro Account.
When are more countries being added to the eligible list?
No official timeline. Topstep is actively working on it as partnerships expand.
What about countries with human rights violations?
While we do not control every country's rules and regulations, we will continue to support as many countries as OFAC and our brokers will allow us to.
My country was previously eligible, but now it's ineligible. Am I still eligible to trade with Topstep?
A country may be deemed ineligible for several reasons, including, but not limited to, OFAC sanctions and restrictions with our partners. In these cases, traders are unable to trade with, get Funded by, or receive payouts from Topstep.
November 17, 2026 Update: Newly Ineligible Countries
What is changing, and who does it affect?
Effective Nov. 17, Topstep no longer offers new accounts or purchases to Traders whose account address is in Andorra, Cambodia, Ethiopia, Guinea, Kyrgyzstan, Laos, Macao, Mozambique, Namibia, Senegal, Serbia, Uzbekistan or Zimbabwe. Traders in these countries will have new purchases and profile edits blocked. Trading, Payouts, call-ups and Express Funded Account activation fees still work through December 31, 2026.
Why is this happening, and is it about me?
Recently, we've seen a sharp rise in coordinated abuse from several countries. When we closed those accounts, the same activity returned through new profiles, so we made the difficult decision to restrict access at the country level. We know this affects many Traders who had no part in it, and we don't take that lightly.
​
This is a business decision. For a long time, Topstep worked to keep Traders in these countries eligible, going further than many other firms in our industry. We’ve decided we can no longer offer new accounts there. It’s based on where you live, not on you or how you trade, and we’re grateful to everyone in these countries who has been part of the Topstep community.
What happens to my funded accounts?
You keep them. Express Funded Accounts, Live Funded Accounts, and any Challenge or Labs drop that has reached its funded stage keep trading, requesting Payouts and getting called up to Live under the usual rules, before and after December 31. However, Back2Funded is not available. If a funded account closes after Dec 31st, a new one can’t be started, including through Back2Funded or a new Trading Combine.
What happens to my Trading Combine?
Your subscription is cancelled and won’t rebill, so you won’t be charged again. You can keep trading until your paid-through date (find this on your Billing page) or 5 p.m. CT on Thursday, Dec. 31, 2026, whichever comes first. There’s no extension, and subscriptions can’t be restarted.
​
​ Can I still use Resets or buy new ones?
You can use banked Resets on any Trading Combine still in its paid period. This is an exception to the usual rule that a cancelled Trading Combine can’t be Reset. You can’t buy new Resets, or any other product (Trading Combines, Back2Funded, Challenges, Labs drops), including offers you already received. Although you can use a banked Reset, a Reset doesn’t extend how long the Trading Combine stays open. It will only Reset the balance and violation history.
I passed my Trading Combine but haven’t activated my XFA. Is there a deadline?
Yes. Normally there’s no deadline, but for Traders in these countries activation closes at 5 p.m. CT on Thursday, Dec. 31, 2026. This includes Trading Combines passed before Nov. 17.
What about my Challenge or Labs drop?
It keeps trading until it expires under its usual terms or the cutoff, whichever comes first. If it reaches its Funded stage before then, it continues as a funded account and will not close on December 31st outside of standard account closure parameters (Maximum Loss Limit breach).
What about Level 2 Data?
Level 2 Data will also be canceled on December 31st. You will have access through the end of the subscription period.

pages.title: How Identity Verification Works
pages.content:
Topstep works with third party verification software to verify all Topstep Traders. It's required before your second purchase and takes only minutes to complete. Your information is stored on an encrypted server with Topstep's verification partner.
Additionally, identity verification is also required for requesting Payouts, ensuring compliance with Topstep’s policies.
When Is Identity Verification Required?
After your first purchase, you'll receive an email when it's time to verify. You'll also see a banner on your Topstep Dashboard. You can still log in and trade during this time, but no additional purchases — new accounts, Resets, etc. — will be processed until verification is complete.
What You Need
A valid, unexpired original physical government-issued ID: Passport, Driver's License, or National ID card
A device with a camera (phone or computer)
Not accepted: photocopies, images displayed on another screen, or IDs with sticky notes or coverings.
How to Complete Identity Verification
Prepare your unexpired, physical ID
Open the secure link or QR code from your email
Take clear photos of your ID (front and back where applicable)
Take a selfie
Submit
Once complete, your account status updates to Verification Complete .
Troubleshooting
If you're having issues:
Try a different browser (Chrome, Safari) or a different device
Clear your browser's cache and cookies, then restart your device
Make sure camera and microphone access are enabled
Confirm your ID is unexpired and a physical document (not a photocopy)
Resubmit using the secure link or QR code from your email
Avoid using VPNs or VPS — location discrepancies can cause verification issues
Ensure your device's time zone and location settings are accurate
FAQ
Why am I being asked to verify again?
Topstep may request re-verification if a prior submission needs clarification. Respond promptly and provide the required documents.
Can I trade while waiting to complete Identity Verification?
Yes. You can still log in and trade. However, no additional purchases will be processed until verification is complete.
How long does verification take?
It should take a few minutes if your ID is ready and in good condition.
It says my account is locked. What do I do?
If, after attempting to complete the identity verification process, you see a banner that says your account is fully locked and to contact Trader Support, please reach out here

pages.title: General Platform Troubleshooting
pages.content:
⚠️ Please note: If you experience any issue while trading, stop immediately and contact the Trader Support Team . If you continue trading after an issue, exception requests may not be reviewed or approved in most cases.
Recommendations
Hardwire your connection
Use a wired connection whenever possible. WiFi can drop for a split second and interrupt order submission or log you out. Mobile data can cause IP address changes. Trade from a stable, high-speed wired connection.
Limit open sessions
Too many tabs or sessions degrade performance. Use a single tab or the desktop version of the platform.
Reduce charts and indicators
Multiple charts running multiple indicators in fast markets can cause lag or freezing. Reduce active charts and indicators if you notice performance issues.
Update and restart
Restart your device regularly. Keep your platform, operating system, and graphics drivers up to date.
Check device specs
Component
| Minimum
| Recommended
RAM
| 8GB
| 16GB
Processor
| 4–6 core (i5)
| i7, i9, or M1
Storage
| 250GB SSD
| 250GB+ SSD
Switch from tick charts to time-based charts
Tick charts are resource-intensive. If you’re experiencing lag, switch to a larger timeframe chart.
Close background programs & refresh your browser
Close anything not needed while trading. Try refreshing your browser.

👉 Recommended browser: Google Chrome.
Note: Topstep does not offer courtesy adjustments for connectivity issues. Internet instability is outside Topstep’s control and responsibility.
💻 Login Issues
👉 IMPORTANT: Your Topstep Dashboard login and your platform (TopstepX) login are the SAME login. They share the same email and the same password. Use your Dashboard email and password on both. If you reset your password, it changes for both.
Confirm your subscription is active. If your Trading Combine closed due to cancellation or past-due payment, you won’t be able to log in. Check your billing page .
Check your credentials. Usernames and passwords are case-sensitive.
Type credentials manually. Auto-fill tools can cause login failures.
📱Trading on Mobile
Topstep recommends trading on a desktop or laptop for best stability. We’re unable to troubleshoot mobile-specific issues. If you do trade on mobile:
Use stop-loss orders to protect against unexpected disconnections
Use a hardwired connection over WiFi when possible
🚫 Why Are My Orders Being Rejected?
Hit the Maximum Loss Limit (MLL) — Account auto-liquidates; orders rejected for the rest of the trading day. The account will be ineligible or closed depending on account type.
Trading outside permitted hours — Orders placed outside Topstep’s permitted trading hours are rejected.
Exceeded Maximum Position Size — Your open position is larger than the contract limit for your account size.
Inactive subscription — A cancelled or past-due subscription can trigger rejected orders or error messages.
Trading during a holiday — Markets are closed on certain holidays. Check the holiday trading hours article.
Hit the Personal Daily Loss Limit — Account auto-liquidates; orders rejected for the rest of the trading day.
Velocity Logic Events — This is a CME-controlled market mechanism and not something managed by Topstep. Learn more here .
👥 Escalating to Support
If you’ve gone through all the troubleshooting steps and still have issues, contact the Trader Support Team. Be prepared to provide order IDs and, if applicable, HAR files (captured while the lag is occurring , not after) and a Task Manager Performance screenshot.
Please note: Continuing to trade after an issue occurs may prevent us from reviewing or approving exception requests. Providing accurate Order IDs speeds up every investigation. Here’s how to find them.
🔍 Finding Order IDs in TopstepX™
Select the affected account from the account dropdown.
Navigate to the Orders tab in the Orders component.
​
Screenshot the affected orders (PrtSc on Windows; Shift-Command-5 on Mac). If you can’t screenshot, list the Order IDs manually.
​
👉 Important: Provide Order IDs , not Trade IDs. These are different.
If the order is no longer in the Orders tab (issue occurred more than a few days ago):
Click Export on the bottom right of the Orders module
Select the date the order was placed
Download the CSV and locate the Order ID in column A
Share the specific Order ID only — do not send the entire CSV
​
If the account is closed:
Go to the Topstep Dashboard → Accounts tab
Enable Show Closed Accounts to access Order IDs
☝️ What to Include When Reporting an Issue
Order IDs for each affected trade
Affected account number(s)
Date and time of the trades
Description of the issue (lags, discrepancies, etc.)
Screenshots or screen recording (tools like Loom capture timestamps, account numbers, and platform view)
Bottom line: The market's unpredictable enough. Your setup shouldn't be.

pages.title: Risk Adjustments: High Risk/High Volatility
pages.content:
Position Limit Adjustments
Markets get wild sometimes. Expanding price limits. Velocity Logic halts. Historic ranges in minutes. When that happens, even experienced Traders can get caught on the wrong side fast — and fast losses can end a trading career before it really starts.
During extreme volatility, we may temporarily tighten position limits on affected products. We're talking about conditions like:
Expanding price limits
Velocity Logic halts
Historic price ranges
Rapid, sustained price movement
This isn't punishment. It's protection — guardrails to keep you in the game when the market is doing something it's never done before. Our job is to help you trade another day.
How Position Limits Are Adjusted

Micro Contract Limits
Mini Contract Restrictions
Trading on mini-sized contracts or larger may be temporarily halted for affected products

When Do These Restrictions Apply?
Position limit adjustments are:
Temporary : Restrictions remain in place only while volatility levels are elevated
Product-specific : Only products experiencing extreme volatility are affected
Actively monitored : Our Risk Team continuously evaluates market conditions to determine when normal limits can be reinstated
What You Can Still Do
Continue trading with adjusted position sizes in affected products
Trade other products with standard position limits
Focus on risk management and strategic opportunities
Use this time to refine your trading plan and review your strategy
Understanding Market Volatility
Historic volatility means historic losses can happen faster than normal. When markets move unpredictably:
Slippage increases
Risk management becomes more challenging
Even well-planned trades can move against you quickly
These temporary adjustments give you the opportunity to participate in volatile markets while managing your risk appropriately.
How You'll Be Notified
When position limits are adjusted, you'll receive notification through:
Email communication
Dashboard banners
Social media updates (@Topstep on X)
We'll also notify you when restrictions are lifted and normal position limits are reinstated.
Tier 1 News Events Restrictions
Ahead of Tier 1 News Events (for example, CPI, FOMC, NFP, PPI), Topstep temporarily restricts new opening positions on equity index products and metals in SIM to protect Traders from extreme volatility.
Minis (ES, RTY, YM, NQ, NKD, GC, SI, HG, PL): No new opening transactions permitted during the 10-minute window surrounding the release (5 minutes before, 5 minutes after).
Micros (MES, M2K, MYM, MNQ, MGC): Opening transactions limited to 1, 3, 6, 9, and 15 contracts for the $25K, $50K, $100K, $150K, and $250K account sizes, respectively, during the window (see table below)
MHG and SIL: Opening transactions limited to 1, 2, 5, 7, 12 contracts for the $25K, $50K, $100K, $150K, and $250K account sizes, respectively, during the window (see table below)
Other products (energies, rates, FX, etc.) are unaffected.
Existing Positions: Traders holding existing positions in equity index products and metals prior to 5 minutes before the news event may keep them open and manage them through the Tier 1 News Events window. TopstepX™ automatically enforces these limits , so no manual adjustment is required for existing trades.
Live Account Restrictions: Live traders with a balance below $3,000 will be limited to 1 contract during Tier 1 News Events to reduce the potential for a catastrophic loss should markets shift rapidly.
Pending orders: Pending orders are not open positions. They will not fill during the 10-minute window, and new pending orders intended to execute during this timeframe cannot be placed. TP/SL brackets that are reducing/closing positions will be accepted during the window.
How you'll be alerted: we'll email you and you'll see a banner at the top of the platform, so you're always prepared.

Referral Codes
Every Trader with an active Trader Profile can generate a Referral Code. Anyone new to Topstep who enters it at checkout gets 15% off their first account purchase. Once that purchase completes, the referrer get a 15% reward discount code by email for a purchase of their own.
Generate and copy your code on your Trader Profile.
New : Starting November 16, 2026 your Referral Code is generated using your Trader Profile handle, and Referral Codes no longer expire.
Reward codes are earned and someone applies your referral code to a new purchase. Earn up to 5 reward codes in a calendar month. The count restarts on the 1st. Limit of 5 per month no matter how many Traders use your referral code.
1 discount per purchase. No stacking with other promotions.
The discount percentage is set by Topstep and can change. Whatever is active on the day you redeem is what applies.
🦃 Friendsgiving Promotion: Starting November 16, 2026, through the end of November, your Referral Code will offer 50% off (up from the standard 15%)! You'll also receive a 50% Reward Code for each person who uses your Referral Code. Be sure to generate a new handle-based code to offer and receive 50% off. Please note: This is a temporary promotion!
FAQs
Who can use a referral code?
Anyone new to Topstep who hasn't purchased yet, on their first account purchase only. Codes are public, so you can share yours anywhere.
Is this the affiliate program?
No. Referral Codes are open to all Traders with a Trader Profile.
Can I see who used my code?
Not yet. The reward email is the only signal right now.
Where does my reward show up?
Email only. It's a discount code, not cash, and nothing is added to an account balance. Check spam and promotions if you don't see it.
More than 5 people used my code. Where are the rest of my rewards?
The cap is 5 reward codes in a month. Rewards past that aren't banked. Once a new month starts, you can earn 5 more reward codes if 5 more referrals make purchases using your code.
I signed up but didn't see the discount. Did I miss it?
No. The referral code applies to your first account purchase , not at sign-up. Enter it at checkout!
Affiliate Codes
What is Topstep’s affiliate program?
Topstep partners with a select group of creators, some of whom have an affiliate code to share with their community. When someone purchases with Topstep for the first time using an affiliate code, they save 20%.
What is the affiliate code offer?
20% off your first Topstep purchase (Trading Combine, Topstep Labs, or an Evaluation Challenge) when you check out with an affiliate’s code.
Who is eligible to use an affiliate’s code?
If you have never previously purchased with Topstep, you are eligible to use an affiliate code on your very first Topstep purchase for the purchase of a Topstep Trading Combine, Topstep Labs, or a Topstep Evaluation Challenge. Traders new to Topstep can only use one affiliate code, one time.
I want to purchase more than one account. Does the code apply to all purchases?
No, affiliate codes are eligible to be used on your first purchase with Topstep. Affiliate codes do not apply to Resets, Back2Funded, market data add-ons, or anything you buy after that first purchase.
Can I stack an affiliate code with another promo or code?
No, you cannot stack with another promo code, discount, or a referral code. There is one exception: if you opt to add a Daily Loss Limit to a No Activation Fee Trading Combine during your first purchase with Topstep, you can still use an affiliate code to save 20% in addition to the Responsible Trading Advantage savings.
How can I become a Topstep Affiliate?
We’re launching a new affiliate program and rolling it out gradually, starting with a small group of Traders. Details are limited for now. We’ll share more information here as the program expands!
How to Add or Update Payment Details
Go to your Billing Page on the Dashboard
​
Click Add New Card and enter your details
Scroll to Subscriptions
Click the Edit icon next to the subscription you want to update
Select your preferred card and save
☝ Important: At least 1 card must remain on file while a Trading Combine is active. Removing all cards will close your account. Once you set a default card, new purchases will automatically be tied to that card. To update an existing subscription’s payment method, you must change your default card and update the individual subscription.
Payment Troubleshooting
Use a card in your name — must match your Topstep profile exactly. Using someone else’s card violates the Terms of Use.
Check your billing address — must match your bank’s records exactly, including formatting.
Delete and re-enter payment details manually — avoid autofill.
Wait at least 1 hour between retry attempts — rapid retries can trigger bank blocks.
Contact your bank — ask the Fraud department to check for holds, confirm online/international transactions are enabled, and allowlist Topstep.
Browser checks — clear cache and cookies, try a private/incognito window, disable VPNs and ad blockers, or try a different browser/device.
For refund questions, see Topstep® Refund Policies .
Chargebacks at Topstep
Have a question about a charge? Call us first. Always.
Most fees at Topstep are non-refundable, but we’re always happy to review your account and clear up confusion. Filing a chargeback before reaching out could limit your options and put your account at risk.
What’s the Difference Between a Chargeback and an Unjustified Chargeback?
A chargeback is when you dispute a charge with your bank and request a reversal.
An unjustified chargeback is filing a dispute without a valid reason — for example:
Forgetting to cancel a subscription
Misunderstanding a charge
Overlooking Topstep’s refund policies
Attempting to bypass the standard refund process
What Happens If You File a Chargeback?
Filing triggers an account review. Excessive or unjustified chargebacks may result in account suspension or permanent removal from the Topstep program.
Initiating chargebacks is listed as prohibited conduct .
Already filed one? You can still contact Trader Support to discuss your options.
What If You Want to Dispute a Charge?
Contact Trader Support first. We’ll review your situation and let you know what’s available under our refund policies .

pages.title: Trading Combine Subscriptions
pages.content:
The Basics
The Trading Combine® is a monthly subscription. It Rebills every 30 days from your original sign-up date. Active until you pass and earn an Express Funded Account® (XFA) — or until you cancel. No time limit for passing.
Check your Rebill date and manage your subscription from your Topstep Dashboard .
Trading Combine Subscription FAQs
What does the Trading Combine cost?
Topstep Pricing and Payment Information →
What payment methods are accepted?
Credit or debit card: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover.
👉 Must be in your own name — using someone else's card violates Topstep's Terms of Use.
Important: Prepaid cards and gift cards (including Cash App and Venmo) may not work.
How do I cancel?
Billing page → click " X " next to the subscription → confirm .
Once canceled, it cannot be undone. No resubscribe option. You also can't purchase a Reset on that subscription after it's canceled.
What happens if I break a rule (hit the Maximum Loss Limit)?
Your account becomes ineligible for funding until it's reset. The subscription does not cancel — it keeps rebilling, and you can still trade for practice. You'll get a Reset Credit when your Rebill processes.
What happens if my subscription renewal payment fails?
If a renewal payment fails, your subscription enters a retry period. The system will automatically attempt to process the charge two more times before the subscription is canceled. If you add a new card due to a failed renewal, please remember to update the affected subscription with your new card under the Subscriptions section of your Billing tab.
​
During this retry period, account Resets are temporarily disabled for that subscription. Resets will become available again as soon as your subscription payment successfully processes.
Important: Subscription renewals process early on your rebill date. To avoid unexpected charges or losing the ability to Reset before your next billing cycle, we recommend completing any account Resets the day before your billing date.
Can I pause my Trading Combine?
No. Subscriptions can't be paused or put on hold. It will Rebill monthly until you pass or cancel.
When do I need to pass to avoid being Rebilled?
Your Dashboard must show you've passed before your Rebill date.
Example: Rebill is the 5th → pass before trading ends on the 4th.
What happens to my subscription after I pass?
The subscription tied to the passed Trading Combine will auto-cancel, and the account will close.
You'll be able to activate your Express Funded Account immediately.
Other active Trading Combines keep Rebilling until you manually cancel them.
Payments already processed for the current billing cycle are not refunded or prorated.
Additionally, the passed Trading Combine remains in "Passed" status until you activate your Express Funded Account, ensuring you won't lose the account while waiting to activate.
I passed, but I'm still being charged, what should I do?
Check your Billing page for any other active Trading Combine subscriptions that haven't been passed yet. These will continue to rebill automatically until you cancel them manually. If you believe you're being charged in error for the passed account specifically, please contact support .
Why did I receive a cancellation email after I passed?
When your Trading Combine is marked as Passed, the subscription for that account is automatically canceled. The cancellation email you receive is a standard notification confirming this — it does not indicate any problem with your account or your progress toward funding.
What happens to my Reset Credits if I cancel?
Reset Credits stay on your profile. Available for any future Trading Combine (of the same size/type). However, once a subscription is canceled, you can't Reset that specific account anymore.
Can I reactivate a canceled subscription?
No. Once canceled, it's gone. Start a new Trading Combine to keep trading.
Can I have more than one Trading Combine at a time?
Yes — no limit on how many you can have at once.
​
​ Pro tip: Always confirm which account you're in before placing trades.

pages.content:
Economic releases are scheduled government reports that give the market key data on the economy — things like unemployment, interest rate decisions, and supply figures. They can trigger extreme volatility and rapid price swings that make consistent, profitable trading very difficult.

Trading During the News
Topstep restricts trading for a short period during Tier 1 News Events. learn more here .
​
Slippage is common during these events. Orders can execute at a worse price than expected. That's not a bug — that's the market.
FAQs
What causes slippage during economic releases?
Rapid price movement and low liquidity make it hard to fill orders at your expected price. The bigger the release, the more pronounced the slippage risk.
How can I minimize slippage?
Monitor economic calendars so you know what's coming. Reduce position sizes during volatile events. Use limit orders instead of market orders. Or sit it out — sometimes that's the best trade. Check out the Risk Adjustments: High Risk/High Volatility article to learn more.
Does Topstep adjust accounts for slippage losses?
No. Slippage is a normal market condition. Topstep doesn't make account adjustments for losses attributable to it.
