pages.title: Live Funded Account Call Up and Call Down Process
pages.content:
Overview
Moving to the Live Funded Account® (LFA) isn't automatic — it's earned. And staying there requires the same consistency that got you in. This article covers both the Call Up (moving to Live) and the Call Down (the Shoulder Tap back to a simulated account).
📈 The Call Up — Moving to Live
Moving to the Live Funded Account® (LFA) isn’t automatic. It’s earned. Unlike many other firms, we don’t start you off at $0 in your Live account. Your starting balance is 20% of your cumulative XFA balance, capped at your Account Size. If 20% of the capped amount is less than $10,000, Topstep will add in additional funds to get you to the $10,000 minimum.
How Traders Are Evaluated for Live
Topstep’s Live Account Team continuously monitors trader performance to determine when a trader may be ready to move to Live. Every trader is reviewed individually, so timing varies based on overall performance and history. Traders with Topstep average over $40k in lifetime payouts before being called up to our Live program. 100% of traders called to our Live program have taken a payout during their time with Topstep.
We look at your full trading profile, not just one metric, including:
Consistency and overall account behavior
Risk management, position sizing, products traded, and use of stops and risk tools
Exceptional performance in Sim
Payout history and previous call-ups to Live
All Live transitions occur at the discretion of the Topstep Live Accounts Team.
Are the funds earned in my XFA forfeited when I move to Live?
No, the funds you have earned during your XFA trading are used to determine your Live starting balance up to the size of your Live account.
What balance will I start with in Live?
Your starting balance is 20% of your cumulative XFA balance, capped at your Account Size. If 20% of the capped amount is less than $10,000, Topstep will add in additional funds to get you to the $10,000 minimum.. The remaining 80% is held in Reserve and can be unlocked in as few as 4 weeks through consistent trading in our Scale in, Scale up program.
See Live Funded Account Parameters for the full breakdown of how your Account Size cap, cumulative balance, and Reserve split are calculated, including worked examples.
📉 The Call Down — The Shoulder Tap
What is it?
​
A Shoulder Tap moves a Live Trader back to a simulated account to reset and rebuild consistency while still being able to take payouts like in an XFA. This is standard risk management at proprietary trading firms.
​
It is not a penalty. It's an opportunity for the Risk Team to connect with a trader and help address excessive or extreme trading behaviors that could negatively impact long-term performance.
When does it happen?
A single trade, trading day, or isolated mistake typically won't trigger a Shoulder Tap. Instead, the Risk Team looks for recurring patterns over time, including:
Significant drawdown of seeded capital (excluding profits and bonuses)
Patterns of YOLO behavior or lack of discipline, including but not limited to:
Repeatedly hitting the Daily Loss Limit
Activity that resembles gambling rather than disciplined trading
Inconsistent performance with a risk/reward imbalance — daily losses far exceeding typical wins.
Improper per-trade or per-session risk sizing as a % of account
Continuous over-leveraging, especially during inflection points
Revenge Trading: consistently taking oversized or impulsive trades after a loss in an attempt to quickly recover, rather than following a trading plan.
Large swings in position size
Every case is reviewed individually.
👉 We want our Live traders to protect and grow their accounts, as well as build the habits that lead to long-term success. Our goal is to help traders make the most of the opportunity they've earned, not gamble or take YOLO shots that put it all at risk.
What account will I trade?
Once in the Shoulder Tap program, you will be given one Shoulder Tap Express Funded Account with a starting balance reflecting your remaining Live capital. This account will follow the standard XFA parameters and Payout Policy You will be limited to one Shoulder Tap XFA to trade. Use it to hone in your performance, take payouts, and make your way back to the big leagues through consistent and disciplined trading.
Can I move back to Live?
Yes. The Risk Team continues to monitor your account and once consistency and discipline are demonstrated again, you may be moved back to Live through the standard review process. When a Trader is called back up to Live, they will continue trading in their Live Funded Account with the same balance that they had when they were called down. Any seed capital still held in reserve by Topstep will be available to unlock as the Trader reaches the designated profit targets based on account size.
FAQs
Do I need 5 payouts to move to Live?
No. All decisions are based on overall performance and Live Account team review. The more payouts you take in your XFA accounts, the more likely you will to be selected for a review to move to Live. Those XFA funds are not forfeit, they are used to determine your starting balance in your Live account.
Will I get a warning before a Shoulder Tap?
No. There is no warning before being called down.
Can I trade multiple accounts while in a Shoulder Tap?
No. You are limited to 1 Shoulder Tap Express Funded Account.
Is Back2Funded available for Shoulder Tap accounts?
Yes. Back2Funded is available for any Shoulder Tap account.
How long will I remain in a Shoulder Tap account?
Until you are called back to Live or the account balance reaches zero.
What happens if I lose my Shoulder Tap account?
If the balance reaches zero, any remaining Live reserve is forfeited. You may restart the evaluation process by purchasing a new Trading Combine to earn funding.
Is returning to Live guaranteed after a certain number of payouts?
No. Returning to Live depends on demonstrated consistency and overall performance. It is never automatic.
What happens to my Reserve Balance if I'm called down?
When a Trader is called back up to Live, they will continue trading in their Live Funded Account with the same balance that they had when they were called down. Any seed capital still held in reserve by Topstep will be available to unlock as the Trader reaches the designated profit targets based on account size.
If the Shoulder Tap XFA is traded to $0, the remaining seed capital will be forfeited.

pages.title: Express Funded Account™ Parameters
pages.content:
The Basics
You passed the Trading Combine®. Now it's time to trade for real Payouts. The Express Funded Account® (XFA) is the simulated funded-level account you earn after passing your Trading Combine . Your balance starts at $0 and grows from your trading profits.You can hold up to 5 active XFAs at a time. At activation, you choose your Payout path: Standard or Consistency.
🤜 The XFA is the proving ground. Put in the reps, prove your strategy is consistent, and earn your call-up to the big leagues. Trade with discipline, hit your Payouts, and build the track record that gets you to Live .
📺 Check out this quick video to learn about the Express Funded Account:
Standard vs. Consistency: at a glance
| XFA Standard
| XFA Consistency
Payout eligibility
| 5 winning days of $150+
| 3 days traded, 40% Consistency Objective
Max Payout
| 50% of balance, up to $5,000*
| 50% of balance, up to $6,000*
Profit split
| 90/10
| 90/10
Scaling Plan
| ✅
| ✅
Maximum Loss Limit (MLL)
| ✅
| ✅
Daily Loss Limit (DLL)
| Optional
| Optional
Consistency Objective
| ❌
| ✅
Profit Target
| ❌
| ❌
*See the Payout Policy for Payout cap details by account size.
Express Funded Account Standard
Rule
Do not hit your Maximum Loss Limit
Objectives
Follow the Scaling Plan — the max contracts you can hold at one time — based on your current account balance.
Hit 5 winning days with at least $150 profit each
If you’ve chosen to add a Daily Loss Limit, you must stay within the limits each day.
Express Funded Account Consistency
Rule
Do not hit your Maximum Loss Limit
Objectives
Follow the Scaling Plan — the max contracts you can hold at one time — based on your current account balance.
Trade at least 3 days with at least 1 trade per day
Keep your consistency at 40% or below:
Consistency = Largest Winning Day ÷ Total Net Profit
If you’ve chosen to add a Daily Loss Limit, you must stay within the limits each day.
XFA Consistency FAQs
What is XFA Consistency?
An alternative Payout path that rewards balanced trading. Instead of 5 winning days, you need 3 trading days. But no single day can make up more than 40% of your total profits. Consistency is reset after each Payout.
​ How is consistency calculated?
👉 Consistency = Largest Winning Day ÷ Total Net Profit
Consistency tracking only appears on your dashboard once you have positive net profit. If your balance is negative, build profit first. Consistency is calculated for each payout window. Once you request a payout, it resets.
Example:
Total profit $1,000, best day $400 = 40% ✅.
Best day $450 = 45% ❌.
Keep trading to bring that percentage down.
Why does the Consistency Objective exist?
To reward traders who make money regularly, not just on one big day. Discipline over time beats one lucky session.
Can I have a mix of Standard and Consistency XFA accounts?
Yes, up to the 5-account limit, unless you're on the Focused Trader Plan (FTP) .
How does a Payout affect my Consistency?
Your consistency calculation resets after each Payout and applies only to profits earned afterward. Payout eligibility must be met again from scratch.
Example: You earn $15,000 over 3 days ($5,000 each = 33% consistency ✅) and take a $5,000 Payout. Your remaining balance is $10,000, but your consistency clock resets. You now need 3 new qualifying days on profits earned after that Payout.
Express Funded Account FAQs
Can I have more than 1 XFA?
Yes, up to 5 active at a time. If you pass a Trading Combine® while at the limit, the new XFA goes on hold until one closes. Shoulder Tap account holders are limited to 1 XFA.
What happens if I breach the Maximum Loss Limit?
Your account is liquidated and closed at the end of the day. Back2Funded lets you reactivate up to 2 times at the same size and Payout policy.
Can I mix account sizes?
Yes. Example: two 50K XFAs and three 150K XFAs.
Can I change my XFA size or type?
No. Your size matches the Trading Combine® you passed and is locked before and after activation. Once you select XFA Consistency or Standard, that choice cannot be changed either.
Why does my XFA show a $0 balance?
This is expected. Your buying power is still the full account size (50K, 100K, or 150K). Your balance grows as you earn profits.
What are the fees?
No monthly subscription fee after passing. A one-time Activation Fee applies per XFA (Unless you chose the No Activation Fee Trading Combine). See Topstep Pricing for current rates.
Do I need a data subscription?
No. Level 1 (Top of Book) data is included with your Topstep membership. Level 2 (Depth of Market) is available as an upgrade. See Level 1 and Level 2 Market Data .
How long does it take to get my XFA?
Minutes after paying the Activation Fee . If you pass on a Friday, your XFA won't be available until markets reopen at 5 PM CT Sunday.
What happens if I go inactive?
XFAs with no trading activity for more than 30 days may be closed. XFAs can't be put on hold.
How do Payouts work on a simulated account?
Topstep pays you real money based on your simulated trading results. See the Payout Policy for how to qualify and request.
Can I get called up to a Live Funded Account?
That's the goal — the call-up. The Risk Team is watching your tape. Keep trading consistently and let your performance make the case. Learn more here .
Can I use automated strategies?
Yes, with conditions. Topstep won't help set them up or cover malfunctions. Review Prohibited Conduct and Prohibited Trading Strategies first.
Can I trade across multiple XFAs at once?
Yes, up to $750K buying power using a trade copier. See What is a Trade Copier . Hedging across accounts and coordinated trading with others is prohibited. See Understanding Hedging and Topstep's Terms of Use .

pages.title: Topstep® Refund Policies
pages.content:
The Trading Combine® gives you instant access to live data and a trading account. Because of that, refunds are generally not available once a purchase is made.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method only. Processing takes 7–10 business days. If it's been longer, check with your bank first, then contact Trader Support. When contacting Trader Support for a refund, provide your Trading Combine or Express Funded Account Number, the last four digits of the charged card, the charge date, and any relevant screenshots or recordings.
⚠️ Fraudulent or bad-faith disputes, or reversals of charges for services received, may result in account review, suspension or closure. In addition, we may recover collection costs, chargeback fees and related costs to the extent fullest extent permitted by law. Before disputing a charge with your bank or card issuer, please contact us; we can often resolve it faster. See our Help Center policy here .
14-Day Satisfaction Guarantee
New to Topstep? If within the first 14 calendar days after your initial purchase you decide it's not for you, we'll refund up to 1 monthly renewal payment for your Trading Combine® — as long as you haven't passed the evaluation.
👉 This applies to your first-ever Trading Combine® purchase only. We just ask for feedback on why it wasn't a fit.
Accidentally Left Subscription On / Forgot to Cancel
Your Trading Combine® is a monthly subscription that Rebills approximately every 30 days until you pass or cancel. Managing your subscription is your responsibility. You will receive a reminder email 3 days before your Rebill processes. Manage your subscription at dashboard.topstep.com .
Accounts must have no trading activity
Contact us within 28 days of the charge.
Each Rebill adds 1 Reset credit to your Reset Bank (same size and account type, expires 1 year from issue).
If you've already used the Reset credit from that Rebill, we cannot process a refund.
Processing a refund will result in the immediate cancellation of your subscription, closure of the associated Trading Combine, and removal of the associated Reset credit.
☝️ Rebill refund requests are handled in chat. Windy will ask for your payment reference ID (found on your Billing page at dashboard.topstep.com) and check eligibility against our policy automatically. Eligible requests are processed immediately. If your request doesn’t qualify, you’ll be routed to the Trader Support team.
Promotional Codes and Discounts
No refunds for:
Codes applied incorrectly
Purchases made outside promotion terms
Discounts or codes that were missed
Passed the Trading Combine® After a Recent Charge
If you pass shortly after a monthly payment, we cannot refund or prorate that payment. The subscription payment was required to keep your account active through to funding.
Once you earn funding, the subscription and all fees are considered used in full.
Resets
No refunds on Reset purchases — including accidentally resetting the wrong account or resetting the same account twice. Double-check your account number before resetting.
Level 2 Depth of Market Data
Depth of Market Data activates immediately upon purchase and Rebills monthly on the 28th day of the month for $38. Nonrefundable. Cancel anytime from your dashboard.
Activation Fee
No refunds on Activation Fee purchases, including accidental activations. Confirm the account name before paying.
Back2Funded
No refunds on Back2Funded purchases, including accidental reactivations. Confirm the account name before completing the purchase.
Chargebacks at Topstep
⚠️ Fraudulent or bad-faith disputes, or reversals of charges for services received, may result in account review, suspension or closure. In addition, we may recover collection costs, chargeback fees and related costs to the extent fullest extent permitted by law. Before disputing a charge with your bank or card issuer, please contact us; we can often resolve it faster.
What’s the Difference Between a Chargeback and an Unjustified Chargeback?
A chargeback is when you dispute a charge with your bank and request a reversal.
An unjustified chargeback is filing a dispute without a valid reason — for example:
Forgetting to cancel a subscription
Misunderstanding a charge
Overlooking Topstep’s refund policies
Attempting to bypass the standard refund process
What Happens If You File a Chargeback?
Filing triggers an account review. Excessive or unjustified chargebacks may result in account suspension or permanent removal from the Topstep program.
Initiating chargebacks is listed as prohibited conduct .
Already filed one? You can still contact Trader Support to discuss your options.
What If You Want to Dispute a Charge?
Contact Trader Support first. We’ll review your situation and let you know what’s available under our refund policies .

In the Live Funded Account® (LFA), you're responsible for 3 costs:
Professional Market Data, round-turn commissions, and your platform license.

To trade live, you must subscribe to Professional Market Data from the exchanges. Topstep collects these fees monthly via credit card and passes them directly from the exchange — Topstep does not profit from these fees.
This one's on us! Topstep covers 1 exchange for all LFA Traders.
Default: CME data covered

To trade all permitted products in the LFA, you'd need all 4 exchanges = $532/month total. With 1 exchange covered by Topstep, you're at $399/month out of pocket for all 4.
Why are data costs higher than a personal brokerage?
In the LFA, you're classified as a Professional Trader by the exchange. Professional fee structures are higher than Non-Professional. Your personal brokerage account is likely classified as Non-Professional.
How to reduce data costs:
Start with 1 exchange subscription (Topstep covers it — you pay $0 for that exchange)
Add more exchanges as your account grows
Start your LFA on the 1st of the month — the exchange does not pro-rate data fees (no partial months)
☝️ Important: If you want to start on the 1st, still make your initial data payment during onboarding. Your data subscription won't start immediately — you'll be asked your preferred start date.
2. Round-Turn Costs
Round-turn costs are deducted directly from your brokerage account balance. In the Trading Combine®, a $3.70/lot simulated fee is charged to emulate these real-world costs.

pages.title: I've been banned. What are my options?
pages.content:
Being banned means your access to Topstep’s services is permanently revoked. Your accounts are closed, balances are forfeited, and you are not eligible to earn a Funded Account®. Here is what to do if you disagree with the ban.
1. Read Your Notification Carefully
The email we sent you is the record of what happened. Read it start to finish before you do anything else.
It names:
The conduct we identified — what was found, and when.
The exact section of the Terms of Use that conduct violated.
The accounts and products involved, where applicable.
Open the Terms of Use and read the cited section in full. Most questions about a ban are answered there. If the conduct described matches what happened in your accounts, any appeal will be rejected.
2. If You Believe the Ban Was a Mistake, Build an Evidence Docket
If you think the finding is wrong or unfounded, you can ask for a formal appeal review. An appeal is a factual challenge, not a request for leniency.
Compile everything into a single docket before you send it. Make sure you have provided anything relevant, as you will only receive one appeal.
3. Submit It to Our Support Team
Contact our Support Team at help@topstep.com to request an appeal. Our team will send you the form submission link where you can submit all evidence for your appeal. The items you will need to provide via the form include:
The email your account uses. Include the email address on your Topstep profile so we can match your submission to the case.
The specific finding you're disputing. Quote the line from your notification.
What you say actually happened, in writing, with dates and times (include your time zone).
The account numbers and products the finding refers to.
Supporting evidence - platform screenshots, order and fill records, trade logs, statements, or anything else that documents your version of events.
Anything that explains the pattern we flagged - for example, documentation about who has access to your accounts or devices.
⚠️ Please note: Send it all at once. A partial submission followed by additions slows the review and gives the reviewing team an incomplete picture. Assertions without records are not evidence.
4. What to Expect
Timeline. You'll typically hear back on your appeal within a few business days.
Process. Bans follow a documented review, and by the time a notification goes out, the conduct has already been established against the record. An appeal is a check on that process — not a second chance at the outcome.
Decision. Once the appeal review is finished, the decision is final.
Why We Hold This Line
Topstep exists to find and fund real traders. That only works if the results mean something.
Every rule we enforce protects the traders doing it the right way — the ones whose Funded Account® was earned by trading within the rules. When personal conduct corrupts that process, it takes value away from every honest trader in the program, and puts the whole model at risk.
Enforcing this consistently, even when the decision is a hard one, is how we keep the best trading experience in the industry worth being part of.
FAQs
Can I create a new profile?
No. New profiles created after a ban are closed as soon as they're identified, and no refunds are issued.
Will I get a refund for my Trading Combine® or my account balance?
No. Accounts closed for a Terms of Use violation are closed without refund, and balances in them are forfeited.
What happens to a pending Payout request?
Pending Payout requests are not processed when an account is closed for a violation.
Is there a deadline to appeal?
30 calendar days from the date of your notification.
Can I appeal twice?
No. 1 appeal review per decision.

pages.title: What is the Responsible Trading Program?
pages.content:
The Basics
The Responsible Trading Program exists because we're seeing a common theme among struggling Traders: inconsistency, emotional tilt, and lack of discipline.
If Topstep sees trading behavior that isn't sustainable in live markets, you may be placed in the Responsible Trading Program (RTP). It's not a punishment — it's a structured path to rebuild discipline, consistency, and sound risk management.
​
This program gets you back on track — building the discipline and habits needed to trade responsibly in Live markets.
👉 You may need the Responsible Trading Program if:
Multiple accounts hit the Maximum Loss Limit in one day
You max position a majority of your trades
You don’t keep losers smaller than winners
You don’t use stops
You go full port or trade on tilt, FOMO, or revenge
You disrespect your daily limits
Can't trade small? You can't trade big. Consistency first — then size and scale.
Responsible Trading Program Parameters
While in the Responsible Trading Program:
All new Trading Combines® and XFAs automatically get a Daily Loss Limit (DLL ) :
50K accounts = -$1,000
100K accounts = -$2,000
150K accounts = -$3,000
Pass a Trading Combine®? You'll be limited to Express Funded Account ( XFA) Consistency — best day must stay under 40% of total profits per Payout period
Standard XFA is unavailable until RTP is completed
If you’re placed into the RTP with an active Trading Combine:
Any Standard Trading Combine subscription started before RTP placement will remain as a Standard Trading Combine, and No Activation Fee Trading Combines will remain as No Activation Fee Trading Combines.
If passed, the Trading Combine may be activated as either a Standard XFA or Consistency XFA.
If Reset, the new Trading Combine will follow RTP rules — it will be a Consistency Trading Combine account with a Daily Loss Limit (DLL) and will follow this path if the account is passed.
If you're placed into the RTP with an active Standard XFA:
Your existing Standard XFA account is unaffected.
Any new XFAs created during RTP will be Consistency XFA only
XFAs activated from Trading Combines purchased before your RTP placement can be Standard or Consistency with a Daily Loss Limit.
If you're removed from RTP with an active Consistency XFA:
Your Consistency XFA account stays unchanged
Going forward, you can choose a Standard or Consistency XFA for new accounts
⚠️ Please note: Traders moved from the Live program voluntarily or due to the account breaching the Loss Limit and closing may be placed in the Responsible Trading Program (RTP).
Responsible Trading Program FAQs
How is RTP different from the Focused Trader Program (FTP)?
Under the Focused Trader Program, Traders are limited to one Express Funded Account at a time. Under the Responsible Trading Program, Traders may trade up to five Express Funded Accounts while following a consistency requirement during payout periods. You can learn more about the Focused Trader Program here
Is the RTP replacing the FTP?
Not necessarily. Some traders may still benefit from being in the Focused Trader Program. However, a Trader may be moved from RTP to FTP if they continue to violate our Trader Pledge or carry out the other prohibited trading strategies outlined here .
Are there limitations to what I can purchase while in the Responsible Trading Program?
You can purchase any size and type of Trading Combine — there's no limit on how many you can hold. Each one will automatically have a Daily Loss Limit. For Express Funded Accounts, there's an additional restriction: once you pass a TC while in RTP, you'll be placed on the Consistency path rather than Standard.
Is RTP a punishment or restriction?
RTP is not a punishment. It is a support-focused program designed to help Traders improve consistency, develop the mindset to manage emotional tilt, and instill trading discipline, all while maintaining access to multiple Express Funded Accounts. In fact, compared to the prior Focused Trader Program, RTP allows more flexibility, not less.
Will I always receive a warning before being put in RTP?
While warnings will often be sent out first, Topstep reserves the right to send Traders directly to RTP based on the severity of the violation. Traders are only placed into RTP after thorough reviews from our Risk Team. Trading activity is monitored over time, and placement occurs only if we continue to see patterns that suggest unsustainable or high-risk behavior. If you’re put into RTP, you will be notified directly via email.
How long does RTP last?
There's no set timeline — it depends on you. To move through the Responsible Trader Program, here's what needs to happen:
Get to the Live Program. First, you need to qualify and start trading in a real, Live Funded Account (LFA).
Make $10,000 in profit in your Live Funded Account. Once you're live, you build that Live Funded Account's balance by $10,000 in profit. This profit must come from trading in the Live Funded Account itself, not from a Trading Combine or an Express Funded Account. How fast you reach this depends on how consistent and disciplined your trading is.
Once you reach Live with $10K in profit, you'll be moved out of RTP.
Can I still take Payouts on RTP?
Yes, Traders in RTP can request payouts of up to $6,000 every 3 trading days, provided consistency requirements are met.​
Can I use Back2Funded while in RTP?
Yes, Traders in RTP can Reactivate their Express Funded Account using our Back2Funded option. The Reactivated Express Funded Account account will follow RTP rules and will be created on the Consistency Path with a Daily Loss Limit, regardless of if the original account was purchased before or after RTP placement. You can learn more about Back2Funded here .
🤝 We hope you use this opportunity to refocus your trading approach and build habits that lead to long-term success.
Take full advantage of the free coaching and resources available to you on TopstepTV and in our Discord community .
👉 We're here to support your growth every step of the way.

pages.title: Back2Funded: Rules, Guidelines, and How It Works
pages.content:
The Basics
Back2Funded gives you up to 2 Reactivations per account if you lose your Express Funded Account® (XFA) before your first Payout. Keep the same account size and Payout rules — no Trading Combine® required.
Eligibility
To be eligible for Back2Funded, all of the following must be true:
The XFA was earned through Topstep's Trading Combine®
The XFA was closed due to a rule violation before taking a Payout
The XFA is on TopstepX™ in the new Topstep Dashboard
Trader is in good standing with no compliance concerns
⚠️ Once a Payout is taken from an XFA, it is no longer eligible for Back2Funded. Traders on the Focused Trader Plan (FTP) cannot use Back2Funded.
Pricing
Prices exclude sales tax. Each purchase is separate, final, and non-refundable.
Account Size
| Reactivation Fee
$50K XFA
| $599
$100K XFA
| $699
$150K XFA
| $829
New: Responsible Trading Advantage for Back2Funded
Select a Daily Loss Limit (DLL) at checkout when Reactivating your Express Funded Account, and receive a $50 discount.
✅ $50 off → 50K (DLL: $1,000)
✅ $50 off → 100K (DLL: $2,000)
✅ $50 off → 150K (DLL: $3,000)
👉 Discount is applied at checkout.
💰 Please note: If you added a DLL to your Trading Combine® before the Back2Funded Responsible Trading Advantage launched, the $50 discount will still apply automatically when you Reactivate. The DLL stays with the account for its full lifetime — Trading Combine® → Express Funded Account® → Reactivation.
How to Use Back2Funded
Lose your XFA before your first Payout
Within 30 calendar days, decide if you want to Reactivate
Log in to the new Topstep Dashboard, select your account, and choose Back2Funded
Pay the Reactivation fee (including sales tax)
Your account is ready to trade at the start of the next trading session
Example: Complete purchase at 10 PM CT Tuesday → account available Wednesday at 5 PM CT
Reactivation Window
You have 30 calendar days from account closure to decide
Back2Funded-eligible XFAs do not count toward your 5-account limit until the Reactivation fee is paid
If you take no action within 30 days — the offer expires and is automatically declined
After expiration, you must return to the Trading Combine® to earn a new XFA
⏳ On May 29th, 2026, the Reactivation window increased from 7 days to 30 days! Accounts that were eligible for Back2Funded within the past 30 days will now show the updated time remaining based on 30 days minus however many days have already passed. This includes accounts where the original 7-day reactivation window have already passed. For example:
An XFA that was eligible for Back2Funded 3 days ago will now have 27 days remaining.
An XFA that was eligible for Back2Funded 10 days ago will now have 20 days remaining, even though the original 7-day reactivation window expired.
Troubleshooting
If something isn't working after you've confirmed your eligibility or completed a purchase, here's what to do.
The Back2Funded option isn't showing on my dashboard
If you're eligible but can't see the Back2Funded option:
Hard refresh your browser (Ctrl+Shift+R on Windows / Cmd+Shift+R on Mac)
Log out and log back in to the Topstep Dashboard
If the option still doesn't appear, contact Trader Support — include your account number and the date your XFA was closed
I paid but my account hasn't reactivated
Your account becomes available at the start of the next trading session after your purchase — not immediately. Example: purchase at 10 PM CT Tuesday → account available Wednesday at 5 PM CT.
If the next trading session has started and your account is still showing as closed, do not purchase again. Contact Trader Support with your account number and payment confirmation.
I got the eligibility email / I can see the eligible message — what do I do next?
Log in to the Topstep Dashboard, find your closed XFA, and select Back2Funded. You'll be taken through checkout to pay the Reactivation fee. Once payment is confirmed, your account will be ready at the start of the next trading session.
⚠️ If the Back2Funded option doesn't appear after following the steps above, or your account hasn't activated after the next session has started — contact Trader Support. Do not attempt to repurchase.
FAQs
Does the Payout policy change when I Reactivate?
No. You keep the same Payout rules as your original XFA.
What happens to my previous stats?
Everything resets to zero: balance, P&L, trade history, and winning days. It's a fresh start with the same payout rules.
How many times can I Reactivate?
Up to 2 Reactivations per Express Funded Account. Each is purchased separately.
Why do I have to wait until the next trading session?
It gives you a chance to reset — not just your account, but your mindset. Take the break. Come back focused.
Is a Reactivation the same as a Reset?
No. A Reactivation is Back2Funded — it applies to lost Express Funded Accounts. A Reset can only be used on active Trading Combine® subscriptions. Learn more about Resets.
Can I use Back2Funded on XFA Standard and XFA Consistency?
Yes — both types are eligible for Reactivation.
Can I use Back2Funded on my Live Funded Account or Pro Account?
No. Back2Funded is available only for Express Funded Accounts that are not associated with a Live Funded Account® (LFA) or Pro Account.
Can I use Back2Funded on my Shoulder Tap XFA?
Yes. Back2Funded is available for any Shoulder Tap account.
What happens if I have 5 active XFAs and one becomes eligible for Back2Funded?
The eligible XFA does not count toward your 5-account limit during the 30-day window. If you do not Reactivate within 30 days, the Back2Funded offer expires for that account.

pages.title: TopstepX: Price Alerts
pages.content:
The Basics
Price Alerts on TopstepX™ track the levels you care about and tell you when price gets there. Set them from the chart. Add browser notifications and your computer tells you even when you're in another tab.
Setting up a Price Alert
Desktop: Right-click the chart and select Create Alert .
Mobile: Tap the 3 dots in the bottom right, tap Price Alerts , then tap +Create Alert in the top left.
Alert conditions
Condition
| Triggers when
Crossing
| Price crosses your level in either direction
Crossing Up
| Price crosses your level moving up
Crossing Down
| Price crosses your level moving down
What to know before you set one
40 alert cap. Active and paused alerts both count toward it.
Alerts are contract-specific. When a contract rolls over, its alerts are deleted. Recreate them on the new front-month contract.
Alerts are user-specific. Every alert you create is shared across all accounts tied to your username.
"Every time" triggers once per minute. That cap prevents lag in fast, volatile markets. There is no way to slow it down further.
Alerts expire at midnight (12:00 AM) in the time zone of the computer you created them on. "Till Canceled" alerts run until the contract rolls over.
Sound only plays when TopstepX is open on your machine.
Browser notifications
Turn on browser notifications and your computer tells you when price hits, even if you've switched to another tab or app. Same as a calendar reminder.
Before you turn them on
Notifications need permission in 2 places. This is where most setup problems come from.
Your browser has to allow notifications from TopstepX. You will be asked the first time you enable them on an alert.
Your operating system has to allow notifications from your browser. This is the one most people miss.
Mac: System Settings → Notifications → find your browser → turn on Allow notifications. If this is off, TopstepX notifications get discarded no matter what your browser says.
Windows: Settings → System → Notifications → make sure notifications are on and your browser is allowed. Check that Do not disturb and Focus assist are off.
You will also need:
Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari on a desktop computer.
Your browser running. The TopstepX tab can be closed, but if you quit the browser, notifications stop until you open it again.
Do Not Disturb, Focus, and any presentation or game mode turned off.
Turning browser notifications on
Create or edit a Price Alert.
Tick the browser notification option on the alert.
If your browser asks whether to allow notifications from TopstepX, choose Allow .
Give the alert a custom title and message and that is what the notification shows. Leave them blank and you get the standard alert details.
Notifications are set up per device
These are per computer. Tick the option on every machine you trade from. A second computer showing it switched off is expected, not a fault.
Turning browser notifications off
Untick the browser notification option on the alert. To stop all TopstepX notifications in that browser, block notifications for TopstepX in your browser's site settings.
⚠️ Notifications are a convenience, not a guarantee. Delivery depends on your device, browser, operating system, and connection, and can be delayed or missed. Always check your positions and account status in the platform.
Price Alert FAQs
Timing, expiration, and conditions
​ What exact time does an alert expire?
Always midnight (12:00 AM), based on the local time zone of the computer you were on when you created the alert.
Example: Pick End of Trading Day or One Week and both expire at midnight, either that day or a week out from the day you created it. Pick Till Canceled and the alert runs until the contract rolls over.
​ If I select "Every time" and the market is moving fast, can I slow down that trigger?
No. "Every time" already triggers once per minute at most, and there is no way to slow it down further right now.
​ What happens after a "Once" alert is triggered?
The alert moves to a paused state. Restart it from the top-right corner or from the active/paused alerts menu.
​ What happens to my alerts during rollover?
Alerts are contract-specific. When a contract rolls over, the alert is deleted. Recreate it on the new front-month contract.
Managing your alerts
​ How many alerts can I have?
40 total. That includes both active and paused alerts.
​ Can I show paused alerts on the chart?
Yes. Click the alerts icon in the top-right corner, click the settings icon, and check "Show paused alerts on chart." It is off by default.
​ Can I reactivate a paused alert?
Yes. Go to your active alerts and scroll all the way down to the "paused alerts" section.
​ Can I drag an alert to change the price instead of editing it?
Yes. Drag and drop an alert on the chart at any time to change the price it triggers at.
​ Are alerts account-specific or shared across accounts?
Alerts are user-specific, so they are shared across every account tied to your username.
​ Does clearing the alert log delete my active alerts?
No. Active alerts are not affected by the "Clear alert log" action.
​ Can Support see my alerts if I need help?
Yes. Alerts are visible in our admin tools, so Trader Support can help if you have questions.
Notifications and platform status
​ Do alerts work if I'm logged out or close TopstepX?
Yes. The alert still triggers on the server, and you will see the notification the next time you log in to the platform. Sound will not play unless the platform is open.
If you have browser notifications turned on, you also get notified outside the platform. The TopstepX tab can be closed, as long as your browser is still running.
​ Will alerts trigger while my computer is locked or asleep?
The alert triggers, but you will not get the in-platform notification until you log back in or wake your computer up.
​ My browser notifications are not showing up. What do I check?
Work through these in order:
Your operating system. Mac: System Settings → Notifications → your browser. Windows: Settings → System → Notifications. This is the most common cause.
Do Not Disturb or Focus. Make sure it is off.
Your browser's site settings for TopstepX. Notifications should be set to Allow, not Block or Ask.
Never saw a permission prompt? Your browser may have suppressed it. This happens in Chrome after you dismiss a few prompts on any site. Reset the notification permission for TopstepX in site settings, then tick the option on the alert again.
The basics. Confirm the alert is still active with the option ticked, that you enabled notifications on this computer, and that your browser is still running.
Still nothing? Contact Trader Support and tell us which browser and operating system you are using.
Notifications on Mobile
Can I get browser notifications on my phone or tablet?
Not supported. Browser notifications are built for a desktop browser, and that's the only setup Trader Support can troubleshoot. The steps below are a courtesy if you want to try anyway, but a desktop browser is the reliable option.
Android
In Chrome, tap the 3-dot menu → Settings → Site settings → Notifications. Make sure notifications are on and TopstepX is not in the Blocked list.
Open Android Settings → Apps → Chrome → Notifications and allow notifications for Chrome.
In Settings → Apps → Chrome → Battery, set it to Unrestricted. Battery saver can stop background notifications.
In TopstepX, create or edit an alert, tick the browser notification option, and tap Allow when Android asks.
Leave Chrome running in the background. Swipe it closed and notifications stop.
iPhone and iPad
Safari cannot send notifications from a normal browser tab on iOS. You have to add TopstepX to your home screen first. Needs iOS 16.4 or later.
Open TopstepX in Safari and sign in. It has to be Safari.
Tap the Share button → Add to Home Screen → Add.
Close Safari completely, then open TopstepX from the new home screen icon. Notifications only work when you open it from that icon.
Create or edit an alert and tick the browser notification option. Tap Allow when iOS asks.
Confirm it stuck: Settings → Notifications → find TopstepX → make sure Allow Notifications is on.
If TopstepX is not in your iOS notification settings at step 5, the home screen install did not register. Delete the icon and start over from step 1.
​ Can I receive alerts by email or SMS?
No email or SMS at this time. On a desktop computer, browser notifications cover you outside the platform. More updates are planned.

pages.title: What is a Reset?
pages.content:
The Basics
A Reset returns your Trading Combine® to its original starting balance — Account Balance, Maximum Loss Limit (MLL) , Consistency Target , and trading days all go back to day one.
When to Reset
Hit the Maximum Loss Limit? Account becomes ineligible for funding. Reset it now — or wait for a Reset Credit at your next Rebill.
✌️ Reset your active Trading Combine subscription any time. Limit : 2 Resets per account each day.
Resets and Your Rebill Date
Resetting your account pushes your Rebill date out 30 days from the date of purchase.
👉 Example: Rebill Aug 30 → Reset purchased (or Reset Credit applied) Aug 25 → new Rebill date Sep 25.
Reset Credits
Every monthly Rebill adds 1 Reset Credit to your Reset Bank. Works exactly like a purchased Reset — including the 30-day Rebill push.
Reset Credits stay on your profile, even if you cancel the associated subscription. Available for a new Trading Combine you buy in the future.
Rules:
Tied to a specific account size AND type (Standard, No Activation Fee, or DLL)
Credits issued before 12/11/2025 — no expiration
Credits issued on or after 12/11/2025 — expire 1 year after added
Can't transfer between types or sizes
Can't combine (two 50K credits can't Reset a 100K)
Can't use credits to buy a new Trading Combine — only on an existing active subscription
Oldest matching credit will be used first
Reset FAQs
What does a Reset cost?
Topstep Pricing and Payment Questions
Can I Reset an Express Funded Account (XFA) or Live Funded Account (LFA)?
No. Resets only work on active Trading Combine subscriptions. For Express Funded Accounts, use Back2Funded. Learn more →
Does a Reset change my Rebill date?
Yes. Applying a Reset pushes your Rebill date out 30 days from the purchase date.
Can I get a refund for a purchased Reset, or reverse an applied Reset Credit?
No. Once Reset, it's done. Always double-check the account number before confirming. If your account was in profit before the Reset and no trades were placed after, Support may adjust your new profit target.
How do I Reset my Trading Combine?
You can Reset your account in the Topstep Dashboard or the TopstepX platform once your Trading Combine breaches the Maximum Loss Limit.
Dashboard → select the active Trading Combine → click Reset → confirm. Eligible credits show automatically. No matching credit? Purchase one directly.
TopstepX → Trading Combine breaches Maximum Loss Limit → Pop-up appears that shows option to Reset.
Is a Reset the same as Back2Funded?
No. Resets are for active Trading Combine subscriptions. Back2Funded reactivates a lost Express Funded Account for a fee. Learn more →
How do I get a free Reset?
Topstep sometimes offers free Resets on TopstepTV and through the newsletter. Subscribe to stay in the loop.

pages.title: Express Funded Account™ Activation
pages.content:
XFA Activation — Trading Combine®
This article covers XFA activation for traders with a passed 50K, 100K, or 150K Trading Combine® (account prefix: 50KTC, 100KTC, or 150KTC). Activation is done directly from your Trade Report. Depending on the subscription path you chose, there may or may not be an activation fee.
What to Expect After Passing
You'll receive a confirmation email from Topstep
Your Trade Report will show a "Start Express Funded Account!" button on the right side — click it to begin
It may take up to 30 minutes for your Trading Combine status to reflect as passed in your dashboard
You'll see your Funded Trader Certificate in the Achievements tab of your Topstep Dashboard!
Starting Balance
Your Express Funded Account starts with a $0 balance — this is expected and correct. The account size you see (e.g. $50,000) is your buying power , not a cash balance. Your Trading Combine balance does not carry over to your XFA. Your balance grows from $0 as you earn profits from trading.
☝️ If you already have 5 active XFAs or a Live Funded Account®, the button will be greyed out. You'll need to close an account before activating a new one.
Activation Fee
Path
| Fee
Standard Path
| $149 one-time activation fee per XFA
No Activation Fee Path
| No activation fee
⚠️ It's your responsibility to confirm you're activating the correct account. Topstep does not provide refunds or make exceptions for activating the wrong XFA.
Steps to Activate
From the Trade Report of your passed Trading Combine®, click "Activate Express Funded Account." If you have multiple passed Trading Combines, confirm the correct account before clicking.
​
Select your XFA type — Standard or Consistency. Learn more: XFA Parameters .
​
Account Info: Review the Trading Combine name you're activating and confirm it's correct.
​
Review Agreement: Read the XFA Agreement document and click Continue .
​
Agreement Signed: Check both boxes to confirm you've read and agreed to the terms. Click "Agree and Continue."
​
Activation Fee:
No Activation Fee path: Click Continue — your account is created!
Standard path: Check all 3 fee agreement boxes, enter your payment info (credit or debit card), and click "Complete Payment to Activate."
​
Account Created: You'll see a "Tips from our Coaches" page. The left side shows a confirmation of each completed step. Click "Finish" to return to your dashboard and your new XFA.

pages.title: Getting Started with the Topstep Dashboard
pages.content:
The Basics
One place. Everything in real time. The Dashboard is where you track progress, manage accounts, and handle Payouts and Resets — the moment you need to. To get started, sign up here .
What You Can Do on the Dashboard
Instant Express Funded Account® (XFA) Activation — Hit your Profit Target and activate your XFA in real time.
Payout Tracker & Instant Deductions — Monitor Payout requests in real time. Amounts deduct instantly so you can get back to trading.
Resets Extend Rebill Dates — Each Reset adds 30 days to your rebill date.
Performance Stats — Real-time trading progress and metrics.
Account & Profile Management — Manage Resets, rebill dates, and Payouts in one place.
IDV & Funded Trader Certificates — Submit IDV documents and view funded certificates and Payout statuses directly in the platform.
Training Camp — Learn the basics of Futures trading in Training Camp through a series of interactive lessons.
Set up your Trader Profile and refer a friend!
How does the Reset Bank work?
Every Trading Combine® Rebill adds 1 Reset Credit to your Reset Bank. Credits are tied to a specific account size and path (Standard, Daily Loss Limit, or No Activation Fee) and expire 1 year after issue.
👉 Your Dashboard shows: how many Reset Credits you have, which sizes and paths they apply to, and expiration dates. The system always applies the oldest matching Reset Credit first.
How to Apply a Reset
Log into your Topstep Dashboard.
Select the active Trading Combine® you want to Reset.
Click Reset .
If you have eligible Reset Credits, you'll see how many apply.
Confirm the Reset.
No eligible Reset Credit? You can purchase one directly for that account size and path.
Changing Your Email Address
To update your email, contact Trader Support with:
Your Topstep username
Last 4 digits of the card on file
This verifies your identity so we can process the request quickly. Review our Single Profile Policy below before reaching out.
Please note: this process covers email address updates only; it does not apply to converting a Google/social login to an email login, which is not currently supported.
Changing Your Name
Minor typos or errors in your legal name? Trader Support can correct those.
We cannot update a profile to reflect a completely different name, and we cannot transfer profiles between individuals. Contact Trader Support to get started.
Single Profile Policy
Each Trader is permitted one Topstep profile . Multiple profiles violate our Terms of Use and may result in:
Profiles or Trading Combines® closed without warning
Temporary or permanent account suspension
Do not create a new profile when purchasing additional Trading Combines®. All accounts must live under a single profile. Profiles cannot be transferred between individuals.
Set up your Trader Profile
Your Trader Profile is a public facing page where you can show who you are and share your trading journey. It's optional, and it has no effect on your Trading Combine®, funded account, or Payouts.
Where to find it: Dashboard → Profile → Public Trader Profile.
What you can show:
Avatar, background, and a custom handle
Location, bio, and time with Topstep
Discord handle (X, Reddit, and Instagram coming soon)
Trading preferences, badges, Proof of Payouts, stats, and Profit Calendar
Nothing displays by default. Every section has its own toggle, so you choose what's visible and when.
⚠️ Your handle is permanent. Pick carefully: it can't be changed after you set it. Handles are 6 to 16 characters, no numbers, special characters, or spaces.
Trader Profile: Referral Codes
Every Trader with an active Trader Profile can generate a referral code. Anyone new to Topstep who enters it at checkout gets 15% off their first account purchase. Once that purchase completes, the referrer gets a 15% reward discount code by email for a purchase of their own. Learn more about Referral Codes here .
Trader Profiles FAQs
Who can create a Trader Profile?
All active Topstep Traders. Practice Accounts won't show up in the list of accounts you can select for your profile.
Who can see my profile?
Only people you share your link with. Profiles live at social.topstep.com with a unique URL and aren't discoverable on the public web.
Will my dollar amounts be public?
Only if you turn on All-Time Payouts, Proof of Payouts, Trading Stats, or Profit Calendar. Those show real dollar amounts and are optional.
Can I edit, hide, or delete my profile?
Yes, any time. Changes to your sharing preferences take effect within seconds. Your handle is the 1 thing you can't change.
Can I have more than 1 profile?
No. 1 profile per Trader account and email.
Can I edit my stats?
No. Stats pull from Topstep data for accuracy. You only choose whether to display them.
What happens to my profile if my account closes?
It stays as is. You can hide or delete it any time, regardless of account status.
Go through Training Camp
Training Camp is a guided practice mode inside your Topstep Dashboard that teaches Trading fundamentals and builds confidence. You have access to this before you even buy a Trading Combine!

pages.content:
Overview
Holidays bring shortened or closed markets. All account types must close positions 15 minutes before any early close. Positions still open at the cutoff are auto-liquidated. Topstep emails details before each holiday.
Position Close Rule
Close all positions 15 minutes before early close (e.g., close by 11:45 CT for a 12:00 CT close)
Applies to: Trading Combine®, Express Funded Account® (XFA), Live Funded Account® (LFA)
Open positions at the cutoff will be auto-liquidated

CME Protocol
What Is the CME Holiday Protocol?
On certain holidays, the CME (Chicago Mercantile Exchange) operates on a shortened trading schedule. Rather than treating each calendar day as a separate trading session, the CME may blend multiple calendar days into a single trading day — meaning all profits, losses, and drawdowns accumulated across that window are counted together as one session.
Example: If a holiday falls on a Monday with reduced trading hours, the CME may treat the period from Sunday's market open through Tuesday's market close as a single trading day.
How Does a Blended Trade Date Affect Your Daily Loss Limit (DLL)?
This is an important distinction that can directly impact your ability to trade. Your DLL applies to the entire blended session — not each calendar day within it. Here's what that means in practice:
If you hit your DLL during the abbreviated holiday session (e.g., Monday), your account will be locked for the remainder of that blended trading day — which may extend into Tuesday's session.
Even though Tuesday feels like a brand new day, the platform will still consider you to be within the same trade date until the blended session officially closes.
You would not be able to resume trading until the blended session ends and a new trade date begins.
Bottom line: On a blended trade date, hitting your DLL earlier in the session can prevent you from trading further into what you may think of as the "next" calendar day.
​
​ What If My Platform Does NOT Follow the CME Protocol?
If your platform does not follow the CME Protocol, each calendar day is treated independently — regardless of holidays or shortened hours.
​
​ Does My Platform Follow the CME Protocol?
If you trade a Live Funded Account on TopstepX , you are subject to blended trade dates during CME holidays and should plan your risk accordingly. See table below.
Account Type
| CME Protocol
Live Funded Account®
| Yes
Trading Combine®
| No
Express Funded Account®
| No
Key Takeaway: Before trading around a holiday, always confirm whether your account type follows the CME Protocol. If it does, treat the entire blended session as a single trading day when managing your daily risk.

pages.title: TopstepX™ API Access
pages.content:
TopstepX™ API Access lets advanced Traders and developers build automated strategies, connect third-party tools, and execute trades directly through TopstepX. It's powered by ProjectX and billed separately from your Topstep subscription.
What You Can Do With API Access
Build and run automated trading strategies
Connect third-party tools and platforms
Create custom risk management rules
Pull live and historical market data
Execute trades directly through your TopstepX account
Who It's For
Traders and developers comfortable coding in Python, Java, .NET, JavaScript, or similar languages who want to work with REST and WebSocket APIs. If you use third-party tools built by others, no coding required — just plug in your credentials.
Getting Started
Setup has four parts. Complete them in order — Part 4 will fail if you skip Part 3.
Part
| Where
| What you'll do
1
| ProjectX Dashboard
| Create your ProjectX account
2
| ProjectX Dashboard
| Subscribe to API Access
3
| TopstepX
| Link your subscription to your TopstepX profile
4
| TopstepX
| Generate your API key
Part 1: Create your ProjectX account
Start here, in the ProjectX Dashboard. You don't need to do anything in TopstepX yet.
Already have a ProjectX Dashboard account? Log in and skip to Part 2 .
Go to dashboard.projectx.com and click Register
Enter your email address, then create your username and password
Click Create Account
Part 2: Subscribe to API Access
Log into your ProjectX Dashboard.
In your ProjectX Dashboard, go to Subscriptions → ProjectX API Access
Enter your payment details
Enter promo code topstep to apply the 50% Topstep Trader discount
Confirm your subscription
See Cost and Billing for pricing details.
Part 3: Link your subscription to your TopstepX profile
Subscribing is not the same as linking. This part connects the subscription you just bought to your TopstepX profile — without it, Part 4 will fail with the error User lacks subscription.
In TopstepX, click the Settings icon ⚙️
Open the API tab
Under ProjectX Linking , click Add Link
In the confirmation pop-up, confirm that you want to link your TopstepX profile to the ProjectX Dashboard
Open your ProjectX Dashboard and confirm your account now appears there
If the account doesn't appear, try turning off the browser pop-up blockers or use an Incognito Chrome window. Refresh the Dashboard before retrying. Still missing? See Troubleshooting .
Part 4: Generate your API key
In TopstepX, go to Settings ⚙️ → API tab
Click Add API Key
Copy your key and store it somewhere secure — treat it like a password
⚠️ Your API key grants full trading access to every eligible account under your profile. Never share it, never commit it to a public repository, and never paste it into a tool you don't trust. If you think it's been exposed, generate a new key immediately and update your tools
Cost and Billing
API Access is $29/month . Topstep Traders get 50% off with code topstep — that's $14.50/month , valid every month with no end date.
🧾 Please note: Billing appears as Sim2Funded Solutions on your bank statement. Billing is managed separately from your Topstep subscription.
VPNs, VPS, and Remote Servers
All trading activity must originate from your personal device. The use of VPS, VPNs, and remote servers is prohibited by Topstep's Terms of Use. Running automation on a VPS can result in account suspension or removal from the program.
You may still use your own private server for supporting work that doesn't touch order flow:
Allowed on a private server
| Not allowed on a private server
Historical data storage
| Placing, modifying, or cancelling orders
Research and backtesting
| Any automated trigger that can reach the order endpoints
Logging and analytics
| Routing or relaying orders on your behalf
A read-only dashboard
Receiving copies of your own fills, positions, and P&L
The line is order transmission: your server can watch and record, but it cannot trade.
Important Disclaimers
Orders executed via the API are final — no review, adjustment, or reversal.
Topstep does not support or take responsibility for any tool, algo, or system built on API Access, including implementation, coding, and troubleshooting.
Some traders connect third-party applications to the ProjectX API. If you do, it's at your own risk — Topstep and ProjectX don't affiliate with, endorse, or support any external vendor or platform offering API integrations.
Your API access remains governed by the ProjectX Terms of Use , including fair-use limits.
All trading activity remains subject to Topstep's Trading Guidelines regardless of which platform executes the trades. A rule violation is treated the same whether it originates from manual trading or third-party automation.
Ensure your systems are tested, stable, and compliant before connecting.
API access can affect the potential for hedging — more here .
👥 Getting Help
Topstep does not provide technical support for coding or API implementation.
What you need
| Where to go
Endpoints, authentication, code samples
| ProjectX Gateway API Docs
Full endpoint reference
| Swagger Documentation
Community help and troubleshooting
| #api-trading in the Topstep Discord
Linking, subscription, billing, cancellation
| dashboardapi@topstep.com
FAQ
Is there a sandbox environment for testing?
No. There is currently no sandbox environment available.To test your strategy, use a Practice account instead — same endpoints and real-time hubs, no risk to an Evaluation account.
Can I use 1 subscription across multiple accounts?
Yes. One subscription and one API key cover every eligible account under your ProjectX Dashboard profile. A single authenticated session can manage all of them; you specify the target account Id on each order.
What programming languages are supported?
The REST API works with most modern languages including Python, Java, .NET, and JavaScript — anything that supports REST or WebSocket connections.
Do I need to know how to code?
Only if you're building your own tools. If you're using third-party tools, just plug in your credentials.
Do I need a Topstep Account in order to use the API service?
Yes, you need an active Topstep account in order to use the service.
Can I build and use my own custom trading bot with the TopstepX / ProjectX API?
Yes. Custom automated strategies and bots are allowed via the TopstepX / ProjectX API, subject to standard platform rules and our prohibition on highfrequency trading (HFT). You're free to develop your own system without additional restrictions beyond those standard rules. You remain the owner of your bot and are solely responsible for its design, performance, and behavior — including making sure it operates within all applicable rules.
Can I use the ProjectX API if I'm in a Live Funded Account?
No, Live funded accounts are not allowed to trade through the ProjectX API. The API Gateway is built for the simulated environment and isn't available on Live.
Troubleshooting
Error creating key: User lacks subscription
Your subscription isn't linked to your TopstepX profile. Go back and complete Part 3, then try generating your key again. If your subscription is active and linked and you still see this, email dashboardapi@topstep.com .
My account doesn't appear in the ProjectX Dashboard after linking
Refresh the Dashboard and confirm you completed the linking pop-up in Part 3 . If it's still missing, email dashboardapi@topstep.com .
Where do I find my API Key
Generate a new one from Settings ⚙️ → API tab → Add API Key , then update every tool using the old key.
My requests are being rejected after they worked earlier
Session tokens expire. Confirm your client refreshes its token rather than reusing an old one. If you're being rate limited, back off and retry.

pages.title: Order Types, Fills, and Slippage
pages.content:
The Basics
Order types control how and when your trades fill. Slippage is what happens when the market moves between your order and your fill. Both matter — a lot.
Order Types
All order types below are available on TopstepX™.
Order Type
| How It Works
Market
| Fills at best available price. Fill guaranteed. Price is not.
Limit
| Buy below market or sell above. Price guaranteed. Fill is not.
Stop / Stop Market
| Becomes a market order when stop price is hit. Buy Stop = above market. Sell Stop = below.
Trailing Stop
| Trails the market in set increments. Good for locking in breakeven exits.
OCO (One Cancels Other)
| 2 orders linked. When 1 fills, the other cancels. Used as a bracket.
OSO (One Sends Other)
| When 1 fills, it sends the other.
TopstepX DOM tip: Left-click = Limit. Right-click = Stop.
👉 Learn more about each order type below
Market Order
Executes at the next available price. No price specified — you get the best fill available when your order hits the exchange. Use it when getting filled matters more than the exact price. Fastest way in or out.
⚠️ Avoid in thinly traded markets. Wide bid-ask spreads mean your fill could be way off the last traded price.
Limit Order
Sets the worst price you'll accept. Limit buys go below current price. Limit sells go above it.
Price execution over speed. Trade-off: the market has to trade through your price — not just touch it. You might not get filled. Partial fills happen. Order stays in the book until it's filled, canceled, or expired.
Stop Orders
Stop Market
Triggers at your stop price, then executes like a market order — best available fill. Buy stops go above current price. Sell stops go below it.
Once the stop price is "elected," you're in at whatever the market gives you. No price guarantee. Slippage can happen.
| Stop price placement
| Common use
Buy Stop
| Above current market price
| Enter long on a breakout, or cover a short
Sell Stop
| Below current market price
| Enter short on breakdown, or protect a long (stop-loss)
On TopstepX: Left-click Bid or Ask column = Limit order. Right-click = Stop order. On mobile, tap the order type selector at the top of the Order Ticket to switch between Market, Limit, and Stop Market.
Trailing Stop
Locks in a stop at a set distance, then automatically moves it as price moves in your favor. Downside stays protected. Upside stays open.
Set it and let it work. Useful for exit strategies and breakeven automation — especially when you don't want to babysit the position.
OCO
2 orders linked. 1 fills, the other cancels. Instantly. Primarily used as bracket orders — a stop and a limit wrapping your position. Cap the loss, lock in the gain. Trade management on autopilot.
OSO
2 orders linked. 1 fills, the other submits. Combine with OCO to fully automate your exit once the entry fills. Entry triggers → exit bracket deploys. No manual intervention needed.
Slippage
You set your stop. It fills somewhere else. That gap is slippage. It happens when there isn't enough market depth to fill your order at your exact price. The market moves before your order executes.
When slippage is most likely
Economic releases
High volatility periods
Illiquid markets
Swing highs/lows
Market open and close
What causes Slippage
3 main drivers: volatility, liquidity, and market gaps.
Volatility — Fast markets create a lag between when you place an order and when it fills. Economic releases, unexpected events, sharp moves — all of it can push your execution away from your intended price. Note: extreme volatility can also trigger market safeguards like CME Velocity Logic. Learn more.
Liquidity — Fewer buyers and sellers means it's harder to fill at a specific price. The market adjusts to absorb your order size, and that adjustment shows up in your fill.
Market gaps — News hits while the market is closed. It reopens at a different level. Your resting orders fill at the next available price — not where you expected.
How to Tell If Slippage Occurred
Open your trade history
Find the order in question
Compare your intended fill price to your actual fill price
Check market data around the time of the fill
If the prices differ — that's slippage
Slippage Mitigation Strategies
Use limit orders — Limits let you set the worst price you'll accept. More control over execution. Trade-off: you might not get filled.
Watch the market — High volatility means higher slippage risk. Know what's on the calendar. Reduce size or step aside during extreme conditions.
Manage your risk — Use stop losses. Size your positions to match your risk tolerance. In volatile markets, smaller size keeps you in the game without overexposing yourself. Never risk more than you're willing to lose.
☝️ Slippage Can Affect Your Account Limits
Slippage can push your fill beyond your stop level. When that happens, realized losses may exceed your Maximum Loss Limit or Personal Daily Loss Limit — triggering automatic liquidation. This isn't a platform error. It's how orders fill in fast or volatile markets. Unrealized losses can also briefly cross risk thresholds before a stop executes, which can trigger an automatic account closure.
Risk Tools & Orders — What to Expect
Personal Daily Loss Limit (PDLL) and Personal Daily Profit Target (PDPT) are not resting orders. They don't sit at the exchange waiting for price.
☝️ Here's what actually happens:
The system monitors your unrealized P&L in real time.
Your threshold gets crossed.
The system detects the breach and generates an order.
That order goes to the exchange and fills at the best available price.
Fast process. But in fast-moving markets, milliseconds matter. In normal conditions, the difference is minimal. In volatile markets, it can be significant. Exact price execution is never guaranteed with a platform risk tool.
👉 What this means for your trading:
A resting stop order sits at the exchange and fills when price reaches it — it can execute before a platform risk tool liquidation even triggers.
Your Personal Daily Loss Limit is a backstop. Not a substitute for a stop loss.
If your stop is placed at a level with more risk than your loss limit threshold, your stop could fill first, depending on volatility.
Layer your tools. Stops, loss limits, profit targets — together, not interchangeably.
Why didn't my Personal Daily Profit Target trigger at the exact value I set?
Platform risk tools require the system to detect a threshold breach, generate an order, and send it to the exchange. That process takes time. Even under normal conditions, exact price execution isn't guaranteed — a millisecond difference can change the outcome. In volatile markets, the gap can be more significant. This is expected behavior. Build it into your risk planning.
Can I use my Personal Daily Loss Limit as a stop loss?
No. The Personal Daily Loss Limit monitors your unrealized P&L and triggers when your threshold is crossed. A stop loss is a resting order already waiting at the exchange. Relying on your loss limit as your primary exit means you may not get out where you expect. Always use a stop loss to manage position-level risk. Your Personal Daily Loss Limit is a backstop — not a replacement.
🧠 Learn more about the PDLL and PDPT here .
Orders & Slippage — FAQs
How does slippage affect my Maximum Loss Limit?
Slippage can push your account past your Maximum Loss Limit faster than you expect. When that limit is hit, the system automatically liquidates your position. Build slippage into your risk planning.
What's an OCO order?
OCO stands for One Cancels Other. You place 2 orders simultaneously. When 1 fills, the other automatically cancels. Traders use it as a bracket — 1 side for profit target, 1 for stop loss.
Can I eliminate slippage entirely?
Only with limit orders — but limit orders risk not getting filled if price doesn't reach your level. It's a trade-off: price certainty vs. fill certainty.
Does slippage affect both buy and sell orders?
Yes. Buy orders fill higher than expected; sell orders fill lower than expected.
Can slippage be completely avoided?
Not reliably. Stop orders are the best protection for most situations.
To minimize slippage:
Avoid trading during major news events
Trade during high-liquidity market hours
Does slippage occur in simulated trading and other financial markets?
Slippage occurs in both simulated and live trading across all financial markets — stocks, forex, futures, and crypto. Simulated platforms model real market conditions, including slippage, to keep the experience realistic. It's most common in low-liquidity markets or during high volatility.
How do stop-loss orders respond to slippage?
Stop-loss orders convert to market orders when the stop price is hit. Market orders guarantee a fill, not a price — so in fast-moving markets, your execution price may differ from your stop price, leading to larger-than-expected losses.
When am I most exposed to slippage?
Slippage can happen anytime, but it's most likely around:
Economic Releases
High volatility periods
Illiquid markets / low market depth
Price action around swing highs and lows
Market open/close and opening range breakouts
Why wasn't my order filled / It blew past my stop
​ Why wasn't my order filled?
Low liquidity or high volatility can make it hard to find a match at your price. Limit orders especially — if the market doesn't trade through your price, you don't get filled. Check time and sales data to see what the market was doing at the time.
It blew past my stop!
Slippage. In fast or volatile markets — gaps, major economic releases, sudden imbalances — your stop triggers but fills at the next available price, not the stop price. It's not a malfunction. Review your stop placement and size for high-volatility conditions to make sure they match your actual risk tolerance.
📺 Click below to watch an informative video from Mick, one of Topstep's Risk Managers, as he explains how slippage works.👇
Topstep Risk Disclosure

pages.title: What is a Pro Account?
pages.content:
A Pro Account is offered to Traders who would typically earn a Live Funded Account (LFA), but whose jurisdiction currently doesn’t support live market access ( learn more here ). It’s a simulated account with parameters similar to an LFA. Topstep offers it so you can keep progressing while they work to expand access.
Pro Account Parameters
1. One Pro Account maximum
Traders are limited to 1 Pro Account at a time.
2. Account size (if you have multiple XFAs)
Size is based on the average of all open Express Funded Account (XFA) sizes, rounded up to the nearest standard size.
Example: 2 × $50K + $100K + $150K = $87,500 average → rounds up to $100K Pro Account
3. Starting balance
The starting balance will equal the amount from transferred XFAs, up to 20% of the account size.
Pro Account Size
| Starting Balance
$50K
| $10,000
$100K
| $20,000
$150K
| $30,000
4. Maximum Loss Limit (MLL)
The Maximum Loss Limit in a Pro Account mirrors the Express Funded Account ® (XFA) Maximum Loss Limit.
5. Daily Loss Limit (DLL)
Pro Account Size
| Daily Loss Limit
$50K
| $1,000
$100K
| $2,000
$150K
| $3,000
6. No Balance Expansion
Pro Accounts do not have the Balance Expansion feature available in the Live Funded Account. Balance adjusts only through P&L and Payouts. Pro Accounts are subject to the contract size Scaling Plan .
Payouts
Payout rules are the same as a standard Express Funded Account: 5 or more winning days of $150 (non-consecutive), Payout up to 50% of the account and up to $5,000, and net positive after your first Payout.
​
Account Size
| Payout Cap
$50K
| $2,000
$100K
| $3,000
$150K
| $5,000
Call Up Process
Topstep's Risk team will reach out when you're ready to move to a Pro Account. Your XFAs will be closed as part of this process. This is expected and not an error.
If Your Pro Account Is Closed
If your Pro Account breaches the Maximum Loss Limit and closes:
You can continue trading in Trading Combines and activate XFAs as they become available
Back2Funded is not available for Pro Accounts
Strong, consistent performance in your XFAs may make you eligible for another Pro Account in the future
FAQ
Why did I get a Pro Account instead of a Live Funded Account?
In some jurisdictions, Topstep is not currently able to offer live market access. The Pro Account lets you keep progressing in the program while Topstep works to expand access.
What happens if Live Funded Account access becomes available in my country?
Topstep will reach out to notify you if their Live Funded Account policy or live market access changes for your jurisdiction.

pages.title: Topstep Program Overview
pages.content:
The goal is Live. The Trading Combine® earns you entry. The Express Funded Account is where you take Payouts and build the track record to get to the Live Funded Account. 3 stages, 1 destination — protect your account at every step.
Trading Combine®
The Trading Combine® evaluates your skills, discipline, and habits before you’re funded. It requires a monthly subscription.
Objectives:
Reach and maintain the Profit Target
Consistency Target: best trading day must stay below 55% of total profits
Rule:
Do not let your Account Balance hit or exceed the Maximum Loss Limit (MLL)
Express Funded Account™ — Standard
Earn this by passing the Trading Combine®. No monthly subscription required.
Objectives:
5 Winning Days of $150 or more (non-consecutive) to request a Payout
Net profit greater than $0 since your last Payout
Follow the Scaling Plan
Rule:
Do not let your Account Balance hit or exceed the Maximum Loss Limit
Express Funded Account™ — Consistency
An alternative XFA path with a different Payout structure. No monthly subscription required.
Objectives:
Trade at least 3 days at 40% consistency to request a Payout
Follow the Scaling Plan
Rule:
Do not let your Account Balance hit or exceed the Maximum Loss Limit
Live Funded Account®
Topstep’s prop firm capital. Called up by the Risk Team after consistent XFA performance.
Objectives:
5 Winning Days of $150 or more
Do not hit or exceed the Daily Loss Limit (DLL) — breaching it deactivates your account for that trading day
Rule:
